title: FOIA Researcher - Public Records Requests for Police Bodycam Footage
description:
We're building a small team to source police bodycam and dashcam footage for our YouTube channels through US public records (FOIA) requests. You'll find i
 worth a video, request the footage and reports from the agency that holds them, and track every request until the files arrive. We may hire more than one person, and we're looking for people to work with us on an ongoing basis.



Picking the right i
 matters as much as the request. We want stops with a clear story and a big reaction, not routine paperwork, and we want each request in before the agency deletes the footage.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find i
 worth requesting in news reports, agency press releases, arrest records and social media, and log the date, place, agency and case number.

, from our business

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

s to records offices.

s answered within 1 business day.

Pay

- Long-term work: after the translation, there's ongoing work in recording, review, and coaching as Ilocano grows.

- Translate our full Tagalog curriculum (lessons, example sentences, vocabulary, and flashcards) into natural, everyday Ilonggo.

- Work in Google Docs. Each lesson comes prepared with the Tagalog source and an empty Ilonggo column, so you can focus on translating, not formatting.

- Flag words or phrases that don't translate directly and suggest how a native speaker would actually say them.

- Keep a short glossary so terms stay consistent across lessons.



What we're looking for

- Native or near-native Ilonggo speaker, fluent in Tagalog/Filipino and comfortable in English.

- Translation, localization, or proofreading experience.

- Careful with spelling, consistency, and tone. Learners will study every word you write.

- Reliable, full time, and able to share progress daily.



Optional (paid separately, tell us if you're interested)

- Voice recording: record Ilonggo words and sentences for pronunciation audio.

- Coaching after launch: give learners written or voice feedback on their Ilonggo recordings, paid per feedback.



Pay

- $3/hour, full time, paid monthly.

- Long-term work: after the translation, there's ongoing work in recording, review, and coaching as Ilonggo grows.



How to apply

Send a short message in Ilonggo and English introducing yourself, plus this sentence translated into Ilonggo: "Good morning! Have you eaten yet? Let's study together today."

title: AI Video Editor and Creator (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)
description:
Latest Free Stuff is one of the UK’s largest money-saving websites, helping millions of people discover free samples, competitions, giveaways, and money-saving opportunities. We’ve been featured on BBC Dragons’ Den and reach over 1 million monthly visitors through our website,
 newsletters, app, and social channels.



We’re looking for a talented Short-Form and Long Form Video Editor to help us create engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is a long-term opportunity with significant room for growth and responsibility.





THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled video editor who can transform articles, screenshots, images, raw footage, and ideas into engaging short-form videos that capture attention and keep people watching.



You should be comfortable using both traditional editing software and modern AI tools to create high-quality content efficiently.



This role is primarily focused on video editing rather than content planning or social media management.



Applications will be assessed primarily on the editing test rather than CVs or previous experience. We are looking for the best editor, regardless of formal qualifications.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Video Editing



* Create engaging short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Turn articles, screenshots, images, offers, and raw content into engaging videos.

* Add captions, motion graphics, sound effects, transitions, music, stock footage, B-roll, and animations.

* Create strong hooks designed to maximise viewer retention.

* Repurpose content into multiple formats for different platforms.

* Maintain consistent editing styles and branding.

* Organise project files and meet deadlines.



AI-Powered Editing



* Use AI video editing tools to improve editing speed and quality.

* Use AI voice generation tools to create narration and voiceovers where appropriate.

* Use AI tools to generate captions, scripts, visual assets, and audio.

* Research and test new AI tools that improve editing workflows.

* Help automate repetitive editing tasks where possible.



Publishing Support



* Upload completed videos to TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube.

* Write titles, captions, and descriptions.

* Create thumbnails.

* Ensure videos are correctly formatted for each platform.

* Schedule content according to publishing instructions.



REQUIREMENTS



* Proven video editing experience.

* Strong portfolio of TikTok, Reels, or Shorts content.

* Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, Descript, Runway, Veo, HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar.

* Comfortable creating AI-generated voiceovers and audio content.

* Strong understanding of short-form content and audience retention.

* Excellent English comprehension.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently.

* Reliable internet connection and computer.





NICE TO HAVE



* Motion graphics experience.

* Thumbnail creation experience.

* Experience creating content for consumer brands.

* Familiarity with affiliate marketing, e-commerce, competitions, freebies, or digital media.





SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



After 90 days, you will:



* Consistently create high-quality short-form videos.

* Deliver content with minimal revisions.

* Understand our preferred editing style and audience.

* Produce content efficiently using AI-assisted workflows.

* Help increase the volume and quality of content published each week.





COMPENSATION



Please include your expected monthly salary in your application.



This is a long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.



TO APPLY



1) Send your CV.

2) Send 3 examples of your BEST short-form video edits. Please include links and explain what parts of the editing you completed yourself.



3) Complete the Editing Test

Please create a short-form video (30–60 seconds) based on the following article:



Title of article - Ultimate List Of Free Birthday Stuff for 2026

Link to article - 
/blog/top-birthday-freebies-discounts-ultimate-guide/



The objective is to create a highly engaging video suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Imagine your goal is to maximise:

* Views

* Watch time

* Likes

* Comments

* Shares

* Followers



We are deliberately providing minimal instructions because we want to see your creativity, judgement, editing ability, use of AI tools, and understanding of what makes engaging short-form content.



You may use:



* AI tools

* AI voiceovers

* Stock footage

* Motion graphics

* Music

* Sound effects

* Screenshots

* Animations

* Any editing software you prefer



Please submit:

* Any video format (MP4 file, AVI, MOV etc)

* Please upload to a Google drive, OneDrive etc (please make sure the file is public)



4) Final question

How many 30–60 second short-form videos can you realistically create in a typical 8-hour working day while maintaining quality?



Please submit your application with:



* CV

* Portfolio links

* Expected monthly salary

* A Google Drive or OneDrive folder containing your completed editing test

title: Senior Estimator and sales support (remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for a highly organised estimator with excellent communication skills and exceptional attention to detail.



Your main responsibility will be preparing accurate quotations and budgets, clarifying project requirements and supporting our sales team. We need someone who works efficiently, asks the right questions and follows enquiries through without constant reminders.



You must be confident reviewing drawings and specifications, working with Excel and communicating professionally with Australian clients and suppliers.



Key responsibilities



• Prepare accurate, clearly presented quotations, cost estimates and project budgets using Excel.

• Review drawings, specifications, attachments and relevant
 correspondence before preparing a quote or requesting information.

• Complete material takeoffs and allow for labour, freight, travel, accommodation, equipment and subcontractors where requied.

• Identify missing or conflicting information and prepare clear, project specific RFIs. Avoid generic questions or asking clients for information they have already supplied.

• Obtain supplier pricing and confirm specifications, availability, lead times and quote validity.

• Clearl document the scope, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions behind each quotation.

• Check quantities, formulas, rates and margins before submitting quotations for approval.

• Manage multiple enquiries and quote revisions. Meet agreed turnaround times and flag delays before deadlines are missed.

• Maintain accurate pricing records, estimating spreadsheets and enquiry notes in our systems.

• Follow up with clients and suppliers and keep the sales team informed of progress.

• Prepare a clear handover of accepted quotations, including the budget, scope, commitments and outstanding items.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You must be able to understand what a client needs, ask precise questions and write clear, natural
s.



• Read the full enquiry and supporting documents before responding.

• Tailor correspondence to the actual project.

• Respond promptly and make the next step clear.

• Be confident speaking with clients, suppliers and colleagues when a call will resolve something faster.

• Check names, dimensions, quantities, specifications, attachments and pricing before sending.

• Raise uncertainties rather than guessing or making unsupported commitments.



We need someone who can produce work that requires minimal correction. Speed matters, but quotations must remain accurate and complete.



Improve how we work



We want someone who improves our estimating processes as well as handles the daily workload.



This includes maintaining reliable costing templates, improving pricing records and reducing repetitive administration.



You should be confident using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review information, prepare correspondence and improve productivity. You must check AI output against the source documents and calculations before relying on it.



What we’re looking for



• Proven estimating or costing experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar industry.

• Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions and the ability to build, check and maintain costing models.

• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian client.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and project scopes.

• Strong commercial judgement when reviewing supplier pricing, costs, margins and exclusions.

• Fast, reliable turnaround and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

• Confidence using ChatGPT and other technology while applying your own judgement.

• Pipedrive and experience working with an Australian business are highly desirable.

• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to respond, follow up or complete a quotation.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products and estimating processes. You will need to bring strong estimating fundamentals, Excel skills and communication from the start.



Performance will be measured by quotation accuracy, turnaround times, clear communication and reliable follow through.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader estimating and sales role as you develop your understanding of the business.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or links to download your video.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your estimating or relevant costing experience.

• Your Excel skills and the types of costing spreadsheets you have used.

• How you check your work while meeting tight deadlines.

• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering costing, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Project manager and QA coordinator (Remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company | Immediate start



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for an organised, confident project manager to take ownership of our projects from sales handover through to completion and final payment.



We typically have around 40 active projects at different stages. We need someone who keeps jobs moving, follows through and makes sure the required checks happen before work proceeds.



This is a remote coordination and management role. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must understand construction project delivery and be comfortable working with drawings, specifications and quality records.



You will work closely with our design, procurement, installation and accounts teams. You must be available during agreed Australian business hours to support our site crews and clients.



Pay and progression



Starting rate is USD $8 per hour, with the opportunity to progress to USD $10 to $12 per hour based on demonstrated performance and ownership.



Progression will depend on results, attention to detail and your ability to manage projects independently and improve how we work.



The position is available to start immediately.



Project management responsibilities



• Manage approximately 40 active projects at different stages, from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

• Maintain accurate project records, tasks, responsibilities and follow ups in Pipedrive and ServiceM8.

• Coordinate engineering, estimating, procurement, installation and accounts.

• Track schedules, manufacturing, deliveries, installation dates and deadlines.

• Follow up on drawing approvals, purchase orders, outstanding information and client decisions.

• Track budgets, costs, variations and payment milestones. Ensure changes are recorded and the required approvals are obtained.

• Coordinate invoicing with accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.

• Lead project meetings, assign actions and make sure agreed tasks are completed.

• Identify delays and problems early. Resolve what you can and escalate decisions with clear facts and proposed next steps.

• Provide concise progress updates showing priorities, overdue actions and decisions needed.



Quality assurance and project readiness



Your role includes making sure the right checks happen before materials are installed and before work is covered or crews leave site.



• Confirm site teams have the current approved drawings, scope, material requirements and checklists.

• Coordinate checks of delivered materials against approved specifications, including product codes, delivery records and certificates.

• Ensure material substitutions and changes to the approved design are referred to the responsible person for written approval before use.

• Maintain records of required licences, training, insurance, inductions and permits. Flag missing or expired documents before mobilisation.

• Coordinate required inspections and hold points. A hold point is a stage where work cannot proceed until the required check and approval are complete.

• Review daily site updates, photos and forms for completeness. Follow up on missing or unclear evidence promptly.

• Maintain a register of defects, departures from approved requirements and corrective actions, with an owner and due date for each item.

• Before crews leave site, confirm the responsible supervisor has checked the work and any remaining items have an agreed plan and approval.

• Organise completion records, warranties, handover documents and client sign offs.



You will have management support to hold mobilisation or affected work where required checks or approvals are missing.



Technical decisions and engineering certification remain with the responsible qualified people. Site supervisors remain responsible for checking physical materials and workmanship. Your responsibility is to make sure these checks happen, the evidence is recorded and outstanding items are closed.



Improve how we work



We want someone who spots recurring problems and introduces practical improvements.



This includes improving project handovers, material checks, checklists, reporting and document control.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to help review information, prepare reports and identify gaps. You must check the output and know when an issue needs a person with technical expertise.



What we’re looking for



• Proven experience managing multiple projects in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar environment.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to Australian clients, suppliers and site teams.

• Confidence to lead meetings, ask direct questions and hold people accountable.

• The ability to read project drawings and specifications well enough to identify discrepancies and raise clear questions.

• Experience coordinating QA records, inspections, material approvals or project closeout.

• Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload independently.

• Commercial awareness and confidence tracking budgets, variations and payments.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence using project management systems.

• Pipedrive and ServiceM8 experience is highly desirable.

• Confidence using AI tools while applying your own judgement.



We need someone who takes ownership, raises problems early and follows them through. You should not need constant reminders to complete tasks or chase outstanding actions.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to Matt on WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or download links.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your relevant project management and QA experience.

• The systems you have used, including Pipedrive or ServiceM8.

• How you keep track of multiple projects.

• One example of a mistake you prevented or a process you improved.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same chat. Confirm your earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Production Manager
description:
About Us



Creation Station Printing is a one-source print and promotional products company. For over a decade, we have helped businesses get their printing, promotional products, branded online storefronts, inventory management and fulfillment handled in one place. With our home base in Austin, Texas, and our warehouse in Leander, we serve business customers nationwide.



The Role



We are looking for a Production Manager who knows the vendor side of print inside and out. Many of the jobs we deliver involve our network of trusted print partners and suppliers, and this role makes sure each of those jobs is placed with the right partner, at the right price, and arrives on time.

You will own vendor sourcing, purchasing and the production calendar, from the moment an order comes in until it lands at our warehouse or the customer’s door. You will also support our customers with quotes and timeline updates.

What You’ll Do



Vendor Sourcing & Purchasing

Match each job to the right print partner or supplier based on product, decoration method, quantity, budget and deadline.

Request custom quotes from vendors for jobs that can’t be priced online, and negotiate pricing and turnaround times.

Place vendor orders and purchase orders, pay vendor carts, and keep company payment details current on vendor portals.

Own and maintain our vendor list and vendor portal logins.

Grow and strengthen our vendor network: find new partners, compare pricing, and track each partner’s quality and on-time record.



Production Scheduling & Order Tracking

Own the production calendar: schedule partner-produced jobs and move them as priorities change.

Comfort working in web-based ordering systems, vendor portals,

title: Customer Support Agent – Shopify Ecommerce (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
We run two pet wellness brands (cats and dogs) selling to US customers on Shopify. Our support inbox gets 80 to 100
s a day: orders, tracking, returns, refunds, subscriptions, product questions. We're hiring ONE full-time customer support agent to own that inbox.



READ THIS FIRST

We've hired for this role before. Same pattern every time: great for the first week, then replies get slow, the inbox fills up, and we start chasing. This time we check the numbers every day from day one, and we end trials fast. If you need pushing to do your work, this isn't for you. If you're the person who empties the inbox every single shift without being asked, keep reading.



THE JOB

• Answer 80 to 100
s a day. Templates are provided for the common questions; you handle the rest with judgment.

• Reply within 2 hours during your shift. Inbox at zero at the end of every shift.

• Shopify: look up orders, fix addresses, cancel, refund within our policy, send replacements.

• Subscriptions: pause, skip and cancel requests.

• Tracking: check shipments with our fulfillment partner and keep the customer informed before they ask twice.

• Social: reply to comments and messages on
, Instagram and TikTok.

• Disputes: when a customer files a chargeback, you collect the evidence (tracking, delivery proof, the
 thread).

• End of shift: send your report in WhatsApp, 3 numbers (closed / open / escalated), every shift, without being asked.

• Templates: a new question comes in, you draft the answer, we approve it, it goes in the library. You never answer the same question from scratch twice.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours a week, 5 days including one weekend day. The shift covers US daytime (Eastern Time), which is a night shift in the Philippines (around 10 pm to 6 am). Fixed schedule, reachable on WhatsApp during your shift.



REQUIREMENTS

• 2+ years of customer support for an ecommerce store. Shopify experience preferred.

• Excellent written English. You write simply: short sentences, simple words. Our rule: a 7-year-old could understand your reply.

• Calm with angry customers. You solve, you don't argue.

• Typing speed of 45 words per minute or more.

• Internet of 25 Mbps or more, plus a backup for internet and power. Outages are not an excuse here.

• Your own laptop.

• This is your only full-time job. We don't share you with another employer.

• Comfortable with Shopify, Gmail or a ticketing tool, Asana and WhatsApp.



PAY

$650 to $800 a month depending on experience, plus up to $100 a month in bonus for hitting the reply-time and quality targets. Paid in USD (Wise or Payoneer), on time, every time. First 30 days are a paid trial. After that, a long-term contract and a raise review every 3 months.



NOT FOR YOU IF

• You juggle several clients at the same time.

• You go quiet when it gets busy.

• You answer yes to everything in the interview and then disappear.

• You'd rather be told what to do every day than own your inbox.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly, applications that skip a step are not read)

1. Start your message with the word CALM. Yes, this is a test.

2. Answer these in order: a. Which ecommerce store did you support, for how long, and why did it end? b. Your typing speed, with a screenshot from 
 or 10fastfingers. c. Your internet speed, with a screenshot, and your backup for internet and power. d. Can you work the night shift (US hours), 5 days including one weekend day? e. Are you currently working for another client or employer? f. Your expected monthly salary and your earliest start date.

3. Reply to these two customer
s as if you already worked for us. Your own words, no AI. We test live during the trial, so AI only hurts you.
 A: "I bought your collar 3 weeks ago. My cat still pees outside the litter box. I want my money back, this is a scam."
 B: "Tracking says delivered yesterday but I don't have the package. What now?"

4. Record a 1-minute voice or video intro (your phone is fine): who you are and why this job. Send the link.

5. Give the name and contact of your last 2 clients or employers. We will message them.



SELECTION: shortlist, then a 15-minute video call (camera on), then a paid 3-day live test on our real inbox, then the 30-day paid trial, then long-term.

We reply to every application that followed the steps.

title: Business Operations Manager for a US College Events Company (Full-Time, Remote, Leadership Role)
description:
Hello, and thank you for reading carefully. Most applicants will not. That is the first test.



We are Nightly, a college events and media company based in Dallas, Texas. We produce concerts and festivals for college students across the United States, run a ticketing platform, and are growing fast. Our team is small, senior, and kind, and our culture runs on a few simple rules: own your lane completely, report clearly every day, celebrate each other's wins in public, and treat every night we produce as if it matters, because to the students in that room, it does.



Here is our honest problem, because the right person will find it exciting. Our people are talented and they work hard. What we do not have yet is a senior operations specialist whose craft is making sure everything that was agreed actually happens, gets confirmed, and gets proven. Artists are owed replies, venues are owed documents, partners are owed follow-ups, contracts sit out for signature. Today that tracking lives in our Chief Operating Officer's head, on top of her real job. We are hiring the person who turns it into a system.



Your mission: nothing Nightly agrees to dies quietly. Every commitment has an owner, a date, and proof when it closes.



What you will own:

- The master operating system for open work: every agreement and its age in days, every deliverable owed to us and by us, every counterparty confirmation requested and whether it arrived

- The follow-up cadence: warm, persistent, well-written chasing that keeps relationships strong while deadlines move. You will draft and send follow-ups, log every response, and surface aging items before they become emergencies

- The verification standard: a task closes when there is proof (the post is live, the
 was sent, the document is signed), never on someone's say-so. You will build the trackers and checks that make this effortless for the team

- The operations rhythm: daily exception lists for the COO, inputs for the Friday money and agreements summary, and meeting action items captured with a name and a date the same day

- Process design: when something slips twice, you do not just fix it, you redesign the step so it cannot slip the same way again



Who you will work for, stated plainly: you report to our Chief Operating Officer. She sets direction and priorities for the whole company, and she is the first to say that this role exists because your craft, operations systems and follow-through, should be deeper than hers. That is how we build: leadership directs and inspires, and we hire specialists who are genuinely the best at what they do. If you are the kind of operator who has quietly been the most organized person in every company you have worked for, you will be valued here, publicly and specifically. Our best people are thanked by name in front of the whole team, and operators who close loops get more scope fast.



What you bring:

- Senior operations, chief of staff support, or program coordination experience, ideally with a US or international company, with systems you built that outlived you

- Excellent written English. You will write to venues, artist teams, sponsors, and partners in our name, and your writing must be warm, clear, and impossible to misunderstand

- A systems brain: you see a messy week and instinctively reach for a tracker, a cadence, and an escalation rule. Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skill is required; CRM experience is a strong plus

- Calm, kind persistence. You can ask a fourth time and make the person glad you did

- Judgment about what counts as done, and the confidence to tell a senior person, respectfully, that their item is not closed yet

- Reliability across US Central Time hours, with at least 4 hours of daily overlap, and flexibility during event weeks



What we offer:

- Full-time, long-term leadership role. We are building our core team, not filling a gig

- $1,150 to $1,350 per month depending on experience, paid weekly for the first month, then on a regular schedule. 13th month pay included. We pay at the top of the market for this role on purpose, because we want the best operator we can find

- A direct line to the COO and founder, real authority over the systems you build, and a growth path toward senior operations leadership as the company scales

- A team that notices. The people who create order here are celebrated by name, in public, often



How to apply: answer the screening questions below in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. We reply to every serious application. Shortlisted candidates receive a paid test task (described in the questions) before any offer, because we hire on proof, the same standard the job itself runs on.



Screening questions:

1. Describe the best tracking or follow-up system you have ever built. What was falling through the cracks before it, what did you build, and what changed measurably?

2. A venue was promised a signed document last Tuesday. It has not gone out. The person who owes it is senior to you and underwater. Write the exact follow-up message you would send today: warm, clear, and effective.

3. A teammate tells you their task is done, but there is no link, document, or confirmation you can check. What do you do, step by step, and how do you keep the relationship warm while you do it?

4. Tell us about a process you redesigned after something failed twice. What was the failure, and what did you change so it could not happen the same way again?

5. What hours (Philippine time) can you reliably work, how much overlap with US Central Time (9am to 5pm CT) can you cover, and are you available for occasional evening event-week coverage?

6. In two or three sentences: why does follow-through matter more than talent in an operations role?

We are looking for a Controller who wants to grow toward CFO. You will report to our Chief Operating Officer. When we hire a CFO in Dallas later, you will report to them, and the work you build now becomes the department you helped create.

title: USA Tax Preparer (1040) - Remote, Philippines
description:
Senior US Tax Preparer (1040) — Remote, Philippines

Full-time independent contractor · Work from home · $1,500–$2,200/month USD



Why this role exists

When our clients in the US finish their workday, yours begins — which means returns we assign in the afternoon are prepared and waiting for review the next morning. We’re looking for a seasoned US tax preparer who takes real pride in accuracy: someone whose returns come back from review clean, season after season.



About us

Tax Resolution Services of Hawaii Inc is a US-based tax and accounting firm (Hawaii location) serving individuals and small businesses. You’ll join our established remote team in the Philippines — currently one tax preparer and five bookkeepers — who have been with us long-term. This is a year-round, full-time engagement, not seasonal gig work.



About the role

Twelve months from now, you’ll own a full individual-return workload through tax season: preparing federal and state returns in Drake Tax from start to finish, self-reviewing your work, and turning around assignments overnight with minimal correction notes from our US reviewers. For your first 90 days you’ll work hours that overlap with our Hawaii business day (HST) for training and direct collaboration; after that, you’ll shift to a regular Philippine daytime schedule.



What you’ll do

• Prepare US individual income tax returns (Form 1040), including Schedules A, C, D, and E, plus applicable state returns.

• Work in Drake Tax daily — data entry, diagnostics, and e-file preparation.

• Self-review every return before submitting it for US review, and apply reviewer feedback so the same issue doesn’t appear twice.

• Organize and reconcile client source documents; flag missing items and open questions clearly.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of client tax data and follow our security procedures.



What we’re looking for

Required:

• 5+ years of hands-on US individual tax preparation experience (1040 and state returns).

• Proficiency with Drake Tax.

• A track record of accurate work — returns that pass review with few corrections. We check for this in our screening test and references.

• Strong written English and reliable home-office setup (computer, backup internet/power plan, VPN).

• Available full-time, year-round, with Hawaii-hours overlap for the first 90 days.

Preferred:

• EA or Philippine CPA credential.

• Experience with US business returns (1120-S, 1065) and QuickBooks.



Compensation & benefits

$1,200–$2,800 per month USD, depending on experience, as an independent contractor (full-time, 40 hrs/week). Paid twice monthly via Wise.

• 13th-month bonus paid in December (prorated in your first year).

• Earned PTO that accrues monthly, scheduled outside peak season (February–April 15).

• Annual rate reviews and a long-term, year-round engagement.

Our team is small, stable, and quality-obsessed — clients trust us because their books are right and on time, every month. (Replace the bracketed firm name and adjust this blurb before posting.)

Twelve months in, you own a portfolio of client books that close accurately and on schedule every single month, the daily and weekly review layer you run has caught errors before clients ever see them, and every Hawaii General Excise Tax filing has gone out on time. You are the firm’s quality backstop.



What You’ll Do

• Own full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple US-based clients in QuickBooks Online — daily transaction posting and categorization, bank and credit-card reconciliations, payroll reconciliation, Point of Sale reconciliation (Square, Toast, Stripe, etc.) and journal entries.

• Run month-end close in Double (formerly Keeper) — work close checklists, tie out balances, and deliver client-ready financials on schedule.

• Prepare and file Hawaii General Excise Tax returns (Forms G-45 and G-49). GET experience is a plus — we will train the Hawaii specifics.

• Own the close calendar — make sure every client’s books are closed timely and accurately each month, and escalate blockers early instead of late.

• Improve our playbook — tighten checklists and processes so quality doesn’t depend on heroics.



Requirements

• 10+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping for US-based businesses or US accounting/bookkeeping firms.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online skills — you can untangle a messy file, not just maintain a clean one.

• A track record of owning month-end close across multiple clients at the same time.

• Excellent written English — you will write review notes and client-facing summaries.

• Experience working with Double/Keeper

• Willingness to complete a practical skills test (bank rec, journal entries, POS Reconciliation, close, and an error-spotting review exercise). We test every finalist — a proven track record matters here.



Nice to Have

• QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification, an accounting degree, or CPA.

• Familiarity with Hawaii General Excise Tax or other US state sales/gross-receipts taxes.



Pay & Benefits

• USD $5 - $15/HR depending on experience — paid reliably, on time, twice a month.

• 13th-month pay.

• Long-term, stable role with a growth path to Bookkeeping Supervisor as the team grows.

• Daytime-friendly schedule — your PH morning overlaps our Hawaii afternoon, so no night shift. 



How to Apply

Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read this far. Then answer these four questions (short answers are fine):

1. How many years have you done bookkeeping for US-based clients, and in which industries?

2. How many sets of client books do you currently close each month?

Applications that skip the code word or the questions will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Cold Calling - Private Lender Outreach (SDR)
description:
Nashville TN based real estate investing team is seeking a motivated and talented Cold Caller / Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team.



The primary responsibility of the SDR will be to call the leads we provide (private lenders who have made real estate loans from their retirement accounts), screen them following our proven script, collect information, and if they pass our screening, send them our project details and schedule meetings with the owner of the company.



What is needed is someone with a hunger and desire to work and earn. The ideal person for this job needs to be somewhat of a workaholic. The position pays very well. We need someone that wants a long-term, stable position.



Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be self-motivated, and have a passion for sales and customer engagement.



Key Responsibilities:



- Call and qualify leads by asking specific questions from our script via the phone

- Have friendly, natural conversations with private lenders and explain the basics of our real estate lending opportunities

- Send our project details
 and book meetings on the owner's calendar while the lead is still on the phone

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all leads and activities in our CRM system. Currently we're using GoHighLevel (GHL). We may add BatchDialer in the future.



If you are good on the phone, can follow scripts, have experience with data entry and great communication skills, then this is an exciting opportunity for you!



Pay is an hourly base + performance based commissions on top of that. There is room for growth within the company if desired.



QUALIFICATIONS



The ideal candidate for the job must be able to do the following:



1. Start work ASAP (as early as November 16th but no later than November 23rd, 2026)

2. Fluent in spoken and written English and be very easy to understand

3. Calling hours are from 8:30am to 7:30pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. This is a Full Time position only - no part time. Prime calling hours are between 3pm and 7:30pm Eastern Time.

4. A hard worker who almost never misses work

5. Be motivated by Salary + Commission and willing to work hard to make themselves and the company profitable

6. Have experience with speaking to clients on the phone

7. Install TimeDoctor so we can track your work

8. Have a reliable, fast internet connection and backup power (basically no consistent issues with internet/power outages)

9. Have a quiet home office with a quality headset and webcam (for Zoom calls)

10. Be able to watch tutorial videos and follow simple step-by-step instructions



Please do not apply if you do not meet all of these qualifications.



To apply for this position, reply to this job posting with the following:



1. Reply with the EXACT subject line: "FirstName - EMK Cold Caller Sniper"

Of course, replace "FirstName" with your actual first name.



2. Send an mp3 audio file (using Vocaroo, Dropbox or Google Drive) of you saying the following lines. Make sure the link is public so I can access it:



"Hi Joan, this is [Your First Name]. From the public record I noticed you're with Equity Trust and lending out of your IRA. We have a self-directed IRA with Equity Trust too. I saw you've lent to ABC Homes, and I was curious: Are you open to lending on other real estate deals?"



3. Confirm you have read all the Key Responsibilities as well as the 10 Qualifications above and that you are able and willing to perform them. Write out each Qualification individually and rate yourself on a scale of 1-10 (1 - Novice, 10 - Best In The World).



4. List your requested hourly salary in Filipino Pesos (Not USD). The pay range for this position (depending on experience) is up to P500/hour Base + Commission.



We pay weekly on Mondays. You will receive your first payment 2 weeks after beginning work. After that, it's weekly.



For example:

- work done between November 16 to November 20 will be paid on November 30th, 2026

- work done between November 23 to November 27 will be paid on December 7th, 2026

- and so on



5. Include your WhatsApp ID



6. Give the time range daily when you will be available for a video interview. The time needs to be anytime between 8am and 4:30pm Central Time, Monday to Friday.



7. Finally, write just a few short lines letting us know why you think you are a good fit for this position. Speak about your experience with real estate, cold calling, dialer software, results from calling campaigns, etc.



Applications without these specific criteria will not be considered.

title: Hiring: YouTube Documentary Video Editor | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Project: Worth & Why

Position: Freelance Video Editor / Motion Graphics Specialist

Work Arrangement: Remote, project-based

Compensation: Per-video pricing, based on experience and portfolio

Potential: Long-term collaboration



About Worth & Why



Worth & Why is a new faceless YouTube channel exploring the business, economics, culture, and history behind the brands, products, and places we recognize.



Our content will explore questions such as:



Why do certain sneakers resell for thousands of dollars?



Why are professional sports stadiums so expensive?



What makes luxury brands so valuable?



How do technology companies shape consumer behavior?



What economic and cultural forces influence the products we buy?



The goal is to build a recognizable media brand that produces engaging, informative, and visually compelling documentary-style content.



We're not looking to create generic faceless YouTube videos. We want polished storytelling that makes viewers curious, helps them understand complex subjects, and keeps them engaged.



Our Creative Direction



We're aiming for a combination of 60% premium cinematic documentary and 40% modern YouTube explainer.



Think of the cinematic quality and storytelling of premium documentaries, combined with the accessibility, energy, and visual explanations of successful educational YouTube channels.



Creative references include Bloomberg Originals and Vox, along with the polished presentation of premium streaming documentaries.



These are references for quality and storytelling, not styles to copy.



Our videos should feel:



Cinematic without being overly dramatic



Educational without feeling like a lecture



Energetic without excessive cuts or effects



Professional without feeling corporate



Visually engaging without distracting from the narration



Most importantly, storytelling comes before flashy editing.



Brand Identity and Visual Consistency



Worth & Why already has an established brand direction.



Our primary colors are midnight navy, warm ivory, and muted gold. These will primarily appear in motion graphics, text overlays, chapter titles, charts, and other branded elements.



We're looking for an editor who can establish a consistent visual language through:



Typography and text treatments



Motion graphics and animations



Chapter cards and transitions



Financial charts and comparisons



Historical timelines



Lower-thirds and source captions



Logo treatments and ending screens



However, we do not want every video to look identical.



A video about sneaker culture should have a different atmosphere and editing rhythm than one about luxury watches or sports stadium construction.



The subject should influence the visuals, pacing, and music while maintaining a recognizable Worth & Why identity.



We're seeking consistency, not repetition.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You'll receive the completed script, narration/voiceover, research materials, and any relevant creative references.



Your primary responsibility is turning those materials into a compelling finished video.



This includes:



Editing documentary-style YouTube videos



Sourcing relevant, appropriately licensed footage, images, and other visual assets



Selecting appropriate B-roll and archival materials



Creating clean, professional motion graphics



Developing charts, timelines, and financial comparisons



Adding background music and subtle sound design



Synchronizing visuals with narration



Applying consistent branding



Maintaining strong pacing and viewer engagement



Delivering polished, upload-ready videos



We value accuracy. Visuals, historical references, statistics, and prices should accurately reflect the script and research.



AI-assisted editing tools are welcome when used responsibly, but we do not want misleading AI-generated footage presented as actual historical events or real-world evidence.



Our Editing Standards



1. Storytelling first: Every visual should contribute to the story or help explain the narration.



2. Intentional pacing: Strong openings, engaging sequences, and natural transitions. We don't believe every second needs a new effect or camera movement.



3. Effective visual explanations: When discussing financial figures, pricing, economic principles, or historical developments, use graphics that make the information easier to understand.



4. Clean motion graphics: Elegant, readable, and consistent with our branding. Avoid cluttered text, excessive animations, and distracting transitions.



5. Professional audio: Background music and sound effects should enhance the narration, never compete with it.



6. Originality and accuracy: Avoid repetitive stock footage, minimally edited compilations, misleading visuals, and improperly licensed assets.



Who We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



Experience editing documentary, educational, business, history, or video essay content



Strong storytelling instincts and an understanding of YouTube audience retention



Experience with motion graphics and animated data visualizations



Good judgment when selecting footage, music, and visual assets



An understanding of visual branding and consistency



Excellent communication skills



The ability to work independently and bring creative ideas to the table



The willingness to build a long-term creative relationship



Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or comparable professional editing software is welcome.



We care more about the quality of your work than which software you use.



What We're Providing



To keep the production process organized, we'll provide:



Completed video scripts



Recorded voiceovers



Research and supporting source material



Established channel branding



Creative direction and visual references



Clear, consolidated feedback



We're looking for a creative collaborator, not someone who needs instructions for every scene.



We welcome suggestions that improve the storytelling while respecting the overall brand direction.



First Project: Episode 001



Title: Why Some Sneakers Resell for Thousands



This episode examines the business, cultural significance, scarcity, and economics behind high-value sneaker resale.



We're looking for an editor who can combine cinematic product imagery, historical context, marketplace footage, and engaging financial explanations into one cohesive documentary.



This first episode will help establish our editing style and reusable visual elements for future content.



Before committing to a complete episode, we'd like to begin with a paid 45–90-second editing sample using our script and voiceover.



Workflow and Deliverables



Our preferred workflow includes:



A paid editing sample to evaluate creative compatibility.



Approval of the core visual style and reusable graphics.



A rough cut review focused on storytelling and pacing.



Final editing, graphics, sound design, and polish.



Up to two consolidated revision rounds, with scope agreed upon before production.



Final deliverables should include an upload-ready 16:9 video, editable project files, custom reusable graphics, and a list of external assets used with their licensing information.



We'll agree on file specifications, project timelines, ownership and usage rights, and any third-party asset costs before work begins.



How to Apply



Please include:



Portfolio: Links to 2–3 relevant documentary, video essay, educational, or business-related videos you've personally edited. Please identify your contribution if the work was collaborative.



Your approach: Briefly explain how you would make a faceless documentary visually engaging without relying on excessive effects.



Motion graphics experience: Examples of charts, timelines, comparisons, or other information-based animations you've created.



Rates: Your pricing for a paid 45–90-second sample and your estimated per-video rate for an 8–12-minute documentary, including what is covered.



Availability: Your typical turnaround time, revision policy, and capacity for ongoing projects.



Software: Your preferred editing software and whether you provide editable project files.



To confirm you've read the listing, start your proposal with "Worth & Why."



Final Thoughts

title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist

Reply rate

Qualified meetings

Professional communication

Continuous improvement

Research

Follow-ups

Overall contribution

title: Inbound Real Estate Sales Support & Closing Specialist — Japan Properties

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

• Japan Geography Knowledge

title: Part-Time Accountant (Remote)
description:
Company: eXpand AD  

Department: Finance & Administration  

Employment Type: Part-Time / Freelance Contractor  

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote  

Compensation: US$4–6 per hour  

Working Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time  

Commitment: 10 hours per week



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a digital marketing and growth agency providing marketing, advertising, and digital services to clients.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Part-Time Accountant to manage bookkeeping, financial reporting, payment reconciliation, tax reporting support, administrative expenses, advertising expenditure, and client-level financial performance.

The ideal candidate will have practical experience with US-based businesses, digital marketing agencies, accounting software, Stripe, and US tax reporting requirements.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting and Bookkeeping

- Maintain accurate financial records and bookkeeping.

- Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR).

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.

- Process and record invoices, receipts, expenses, and contractor payments.

- Maintain organized and auditable financial documentation.

- Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue invoices.



2. CAPEX, OPEX and Budget Management

- Track capital expenditure (CAPEX) and operating expenditure (OPEX).

- Categorize and allocate business expenses accurately.

- Monitor budgets against actual expenditure.

- Track software subscriptions, advertising costs, contractor expenses, and recurring operational costs.

- Prepare budget-versus-actual reports.

- Identify unusual expenditure, cost overruns, and opportunities for cost control.



3. Administrative Cost Management

- Track administrative and general operating expenses.

- Monitor software, subscriptions, communications, banking, insurance, and professional service costs.

- Track recruitment, contractor, freelancer, and other administrative expenses.

- Maintain supplier invoices, payment records, renewals, and recurring service agreements.

- Allocate shared administrative expenses across departments, clients, or projects where appropriate.

- Prepare monthly administrative cost reports.

- Identify unnecessary, duplicated, or excessive expenditure.



4. Advertising and Campaign Accounting

- Track advertising expenditure across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and other advertising platforms.

- Reconcile advertising invoices, transactions, and campaign spending.

- Monitor advertising budgets and expenditure by client.

- Allocate advertising costs to the appropriate client, campaign, or project.

- Track campaign revenue and associated costs.

- Support campaign profitability and return-on-ad-spend (ROAS) reporting using financial and advertising data.

- Identify discrepancies between campaign budgets, platform expenditure, and accounting records.



5. Client and Project Financial Management

- Maintain financial records for individual clients and projects.

- Track client revenue, retainers, subscriptions, project fees, and associated costs.

- Monitor client budgets, outstanding invoices, and payment status.

- Prepare client-level profitability reports.

- Track revenue, direct costs, allocated overhead, and operating margins by client or project.

- Support management in evaluating client and project financial performance.



6. Stripe and Payment Reconciliation

- Reconcile Stripe transactions, payouts, and bank deposits.

- Record payment processing fees, refunds, disputes, and chargebacks.

- Investigate discrepancies between Stripe, bank accounts, and accounting records.

- Monitor incoming client payments and overdue balances.

- Reconcile payment gateway transactions with Xero or QuickBooks Online.



7. US Tax Reporting and IRS Compliance

- Maintain financial records and supporting documentation for US federal and state tax reporting.

- Support preparation of financial information for business tax filings.

- Maintain records of business income, deductible expenses, and contractor payments.

- Support applicable IRS reporting requirements and documentation.

- Assist with contractor tax documentation, including W-9 collection and 1099 reporting.

- Maintain records supporting applicable state sales tax reporting obligations.

- Track relevant tax deadlines, filing requirements, and outstanding documentation.

- Coordinate tax-related records and requests with external US-based CPAs or tax professionals.

- Assist with organizing financial records for year-end tax reporting and compliance reviews.



8. Financial Reporting and Management Accounts

- Prepare monthly profit and loss (P&L) statements.

- Prepare cash flow reports and expense summaries.

- Provide accounts payable and receivable reports.

- Track recurring revenue and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

- Prepare client profitability and campaign expenditure reports.

- Prepare administrative and operating cost reports.

- Provide budget-versus-actual analysis.

- Highlight financial discrepancies, unusual expenses, and budget variances.

- Support management with financial data for business planning and decision-making.



9. Financial Controls and Documentation

- Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable financial records.

- Establish consistent expense categorization and reconciliation procedures.

- Maintain organized invoices, receipts, contracts, and payment documentation.

- Support internal financial controls and documentation requirements.

- Protect confidential company and client financial information.



Required Qualifications and Experience



- Minimum 2 years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience.

- Experience working with US-based businesses or clients.

- Practical experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online.

- Hands-on experience with Stripe and payment reconciliation.

- Practical experience supporting US tax reporting and IRS compliance.

- Familiarity with US federal and state business accounting requirements.

- Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, AP, and AR.

- Experience tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, and operating budgets.

- Experience managing advertising expenditure, campaign costs, or client-level financial reporting.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

- Availability for the specified US Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Qualifications



- CPA qualification.

- ACCA qualification or part-qualified status.

- Experience with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies.

- Experience with both Xero and QuickBooks Online.

- Familiarity with US GAAP.

- Experience with US federal and state tax filings.

- Familiarity with IRS Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and W-9 documentation.

- Experience coordinating with US-based CPAs or tax preparers.

- Experience with sales tax reporting across multiple US states.

- Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads expenditure reporting.

- Experience with client profitability, campaign budgets, and ROAS reporting.

- Experience with multi-currency accounting and international contractors.



Technology Stack



| Platform | Purpose |

| Xero / QuickBooks Online | Accounting and bookkeeping |

| Stripe | Payment processing and reconciliation |

| Google Sheets / Excel | Financial tracking and reporting |

| GoHighLevel | CRM and client information |

| Google Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| Meta Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| TikTok Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |



Working Schedule and Compensation

- Monday–Friday.

- 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time.

- 2 hours per day.

- 10 hours per week.

- US$4–6 per hour.

- Fully remote freelance/contractor arrangement.



Applicants must confirm their availability for the fixed schedule and state their expected hourly rate within the advertised range.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

1. Updated CV.

2. Answers to all 15 screening questions.

3. CPA, ACCA, or other professional qualification details.

4. Portfolio or anonymised accounting work samples.

5. Confirmation of availability for the specified working hours.

6. Expected hourly rate and earliest start date.



Portfolio and Work Sample Requirements



Applicants should provide relevant examples of previous accounting work, such as:

- Anonymized Xero or QuickBooks reports.

- Profit and loss statements.

- Cash flow reports.

- Bank and Stripe reconciliations.

- CAPEX and OPEX tracking.

- Advertising campaign expenditure reports.

- Client-level profitability reports.

- Administrative cost reports.

- AP and AR reports.

- Tax reporting support documentation.



Applicants must not disclose confidential, proprietary, or personally identifiable information belonging to previous employers or clients. Independently recreated or anonymized examples are acceptable.



Application Screening Questionnaire — 15 Questions



1. How many years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience do you have, and what qualifications do you hold (CPA, ACCA, or other)?



2. Describe your experience managing accounting for US-based businesses or clients, including the number and types of businesses you supported.



3. Have you worked with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies? Describe your accounting responsibilities.



4. What experience do you have tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, software subscriptions, contractor expenses, and operating budgets?



5. Have you tracked and reconciled advertising campaign expenditure across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or other platforms? Explain your experience.



6. Have you managed client-level budgets, revenue, campaign costs, retainers, project expenses, and profitability? Describe your reporting process.



7. How many years of practical experience do you have with Xero and QuickBooks Online? Which platform are you most proficient in?



8. How many years of hands-on Stripe experience do you have, including transaction and payout reconciliation?



9. Have you handled Stripe fees, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and reconciliation with accounting software? Explain how you investigate payout discrepancies.



10. Describe your experience with bank reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, contractor payments, monthly P&L statements, cash flow reports, and budget-versus-actual reporting.



11. Describe your experience with US federal and state tax reporting, IRS requirements, W-9 documentation, 1099 reporting, sales tax, and coordination with US tax professionals. Have you supported business tax filings?



12. What experience do you have managing subscriptions, monthly recurring revenue, client retainers, and multi-currency accounting?



13. A client pays US$1,000 through Stripe, incurs US$30 in processing fees, and receives a US$970 bank payout. Explain how you would record and reconcile the transaction.



14. Provide links to anonymised accounting work samples or a professional portfolio, including financial reports, reconciliations, campaign expenditure reports, client profitability reports, or tax reporting support documentation.



15. Can you work Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time, for 10 hours per week? State your expected hourly rate within US$4–6 and your earliest start date.



Important Scope Clarification

This position focuses on bookkeeping, financial operations, management reporting, and tax-compliance support. Independent tax advice, signing tax returns, or providing licensed tax and audit services are outside the role unless the candidate holds the necessary professional qualifications and authorization.

title: Backend Manager for DTC E-commerce Supplement Brand
description:
**Backend Manager for DTC E-commerce Supplement Brand**



**NO AGENCIES. INDIVIDUALS ONLY. Any application that is clearly generated by AI will be rejected automatically.**



We run a fast-growing DTC supplement brand in the pet niche, built on Shopify and scaling with Meta ads. I want to focus on marketing, so I'm hiring someone to take over the backend: customer service, suppliers and fulfillment.



This is a full-time, long-term role with a clear growth path:



- **First month: Customer Service Agent.** You work the inbox and learn the product, the customers and every process.

- **After that: Backend Manager.** You run customer service and the supply chain. That means managing the CS team and our AI support agent, and owning the relationship with our suppliers.



**What we need**



We need someone senior who can think and act on their own, not someone who waits for exact instructions.



Right now we have fulfillment issues with our suppliers in China. I'm fixing them, and you'll help me by following up, pushing suppliers to deliver, and holding them accountable. Over time, this becomes yours.



**Your responsibilities**

- Handle customer service tickets (refunds, cancellations, order issues, subscriptions)

- Communicate daily with suppliers and push them to fix problems

- Track orders, shipping delays and stock levels

- Spot problems before customers do, and propose fixes

- Write and improve SOPs

- Manage and train the CS team and AI agent

- Use Claude to work faster and build better processes



**Must have**

- Senior e-commerce experience in customer service and operations

- Shopify experience

- Helpdesk experience (Zendesk, Commslayer or similar)

- Experience managing suppliers or fulfillment partners

- Hands-on experience using AI, like Claude, in your daily work

- Strong written English

- Full-time availability



**Bonus**

- Commslayer experience

- Supplement or health brand experience

- Experience with Chinese suppliers

- Team management experience



**This role is NOT for you if**

- You need step-by-step instructions for everything

- You think customer service is beneath you

- You avoid pushing back on suppliers

- You're not comfortable using AI tools every day

- You're an agency or outsourced team



**Availability**

Full time, flexible hours. We'll discuss the details on a call.



**Important note about your application**



We use AI every day, and so will you. But we do not want AI-written applications.



Any application that is clearly generated, rewritten or heavily polished by AI will be rejected automatically. Generic applications that could be sent to any job will also be rejected.



Write in your own words, naturally and directly, so we can understand how you think and communicate.



**To apply**



Answer the following in your own words:



1- What customer service and operations experience do you have in e-commerce, and which helpdesk tools have you used?

2- Tell us about a time a supplier or fulfillment partner let you down. What did you do?

3- How do you use Claude or other AI tools in your work? Give one specific example.

4- Have you managed a team before? How many people?

5- Can you commit full time, and are you currently working for anyone else?



Please also share your resume.



Please start your application with:

"loop."

title: Brand Merchandise Graphic Designer
description:
Brand & Merchandise Graphic Designer 



What-A-Treat Heating & Cooling is a fun, ice-cream-themed home comfort brand launching in Houston, Texas in January 2027. We have a bold brand, a mascot, and a long list of things to design. We need a talented designer to bring it all to life.



What you'll design



- Team apparel: polos, quarter-zips, hoodies, tees, hats and rain jackets

- Swag and giveaways: umbrellas, lanyards, badge reels, crayon boxes, event tents and more

- Brand stationery: offer letters, letterhead, customer folders, business cards and flyers

- Manufacturing spec sheets: clear, factory-ready documents for every merch item, built and stored in Canva



How you'll work:



- Follow our brand guide exactly (Pantone colors, logo versions and fonts)

- Present 2–3 proof options for every project to our selection team

- Take feedback and turn around edits quickly, usually within 24 hours

- Once a design is approved, create a spec sheet the manufacturer can build from: dimensions, materials, Pantone colors, logo placement and size, print or embroidery method, sizes and quantities

- Build a reusable spec sheet template in Canva so every new item follows the same format

- Deliver print-ready files (vector, correct sizes and colors) for our manufacturers

- Keep all files organized in our Canva account



You have:



- 2+ years of graphic design experience, with merch, apparel or print work in your portfolio

- Strong skills in Canva Pro; Adobe Illustrator is a big plus

- Experience preparing artwork for screen printing, embroidery or sublimation

- Experience writing tech packs or spec sheets for manufacturers (a big plus)

- An understanding of Pantone (PMS) colors and vector logo files

title: SOCIAL MEDIA ASSISTANT (SLIMEATORY)
description:
Job Title: Social Media Assistant (Content Calendar & Publishing)

Company: Slimeatory

Location: Remote





About Slimeatory:

Welcome to Slimeatory! We are a colorful, fast-paced brand dedicated to bringing the best slime products, and entertaining content to our massive online community. With millions of views and a highly engaged audience, our social media presence is the heartbeat of our brand. We are looking for an ultra-organized Social Media Assistant to take the wheel on our publishing schedule and keep our feeds looking flawless.





Job Summary:

Are you the type of person who loves a perfectly color-coded calendar? Do you know the best times to post on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts? We are looking for a Social Media Assistant whose primary mission is to manage our content calendar and execute our daily posting strategy. You won't necessarily be the one in front of the camera; instead, you will be the organizational powerhouse behind the scenes, ensuring every piece of content goes live exactly when it should, with the perfect caption, hashtags, and tags.





Key Responsibilities:

- Content Calendar Ownership: Build, maintain, and meticulously update the Slimeatory social media content calendar. Ensure a consistent and strategic pipeline of posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
.

- Daily Scheduling & Publishing: Execute the daily posting of all social media content. Use native platforms and scheduling tools to queue up posts in advance.

- Caption & Copywriting: Write fun, engaging, and brand-appropriate captions for every post. Research and apply relevant hashtags, keywords, and sound trends to maximize reach.

- Asset Organization: Receive raw videos and photos from our content creation team and organize them into neat, accessible folders for future posting.

- Quality Control: Double-check every post before it goes live to ensure correct tags (products, locations, collaborators), working links, and typo-free copy.

- Engagement Monitoring: Spend time immediately after posting to reply to early comments, pin top comments, and engage with our community to boost algorithmic performance.





Qualifications:

- Proven experience managing social media accounts, specifically handling content calendars and publishing schedules.

-  Deep understanding of platform-specific features and posting best practices for TikTok, Instagram (Grid, Reels, Stories), and YouTube Shorts.

- Experience with social media management and scheduling tools.

- Strong copywriting skills.

- A passion for digital media and trends.

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.
