title: Street Sales Representative: PHP 30,000 Base + Bonuses (Philippines)
description:
On-site field sales job, anywhere in the Philippines. You work in your own city or province. Not home based.



You hand out leaflets, talk to people face to face, and sign them up to our paid programme on the spot using your own QR code. You get a fixed base salary every week, plus a bonus for every approved sign-up.



What you will do every day



Hand out leaflets in busy places: malls, markets, transport terminals, universities, job fairs, barangay events, and door to door where allowed.

Stop people, explain the programme in under a minute, and answer their questions.

Sign interested people up on their own phone with your QR code. It takes about 5 minutes.

Follow up by text or Messenger with anyone who started but did not finish.

Send a short report every evening: where you were, how many people you spoke to, how many sign-ups.



Pay



Base salary: PHP 30,000 per month, paid weekly, whatever your numbers are.

Sign-up bonus: PHP 1,200 for every approved sign-up you bring in. No cap.

Monthly bonus: PHP 550 every month for each person you signed up who stays active.

Transport allowance: PHP 3,000 per month.

Leaflets, ID lanyard and stand materials are provided. You never pay for anything. Training is paid.



Expected OTE: PHP 87,000 to 145,000 a month (about USD 1,500 to 2,500)

Examples, not a promise:



12 approved sign-ups a week (about 50 a month): PHP 33,000 base and transport + PHP 60,000 bonuses = PHP 93,000

18 approved sign-ups a week (about 72 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 86,400 = PHP 119,400

23 approved sign-ups a week (about 92 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 110,400 = PHP 143,400

On top of that, the monthly bonus keeps adding up: 100 people you signed up who are still active = an extra PHP 55,000 every month.



Tracking

You get your own QR code and link. Every sign-up through it is credited to you automatically, and you can see your numbers.



Hours

Monday to Friday, about 8 hours a day, daytime, plus some paid weekend events.



Requirements



Lives anywhere in the Philippines and can travel around your own city or province

Clear spoken English and Filipino or your local language

Comfortable approaching strangers all day

Smartphone with mobile data

Promo, field sales, events, door-to-door or campus experience is a plus

Reliable, honest, and happy to report your numbers every day



Rules

Never ask anyone for a password, ID, bank details or money, and never promise anyone a fixed income.



How to apply



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph.

title: Bilingual (Spanish/English) Orthodontic Patient Engagement & Scheduling Coordinator | Full Time | $7 to $9/hr
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines based candidates only

Schedule: Full Time, 40 hours/week, Long Term

Work Hours: Pacific Time business hours, 8:00am to 5:00pm PT (overnight in the Philippines, about 11:00pm to 8:00am; shifts one hour in November when U.S. daylight saving ends)

Compensation: $7 to $9 USD/hour based on experience

Please confirm you can work this overnight Philippine schedule before applying.



About the Role

We are hiring a Bilingual Patient Engagement & Scheduling Coordinator to support orthodontic practices in Northern California. You will start with one practice and expand to a second, so you will manage scheduling and patient communication for more than one office.



You will be the friendly, reliable voice patients and parents hear when they call, text, or
. You will keep the schedule full and organized, follow up with patients who cancel or miss appointments, and make sure Spanish-speaking families feel just as informed and welcome as English-speaking ones.

This is a patient-facing role with live phone calls, not a back-office-only role.



Must Haves (Non-Negotiable)

If you cannot check every box below, please do not apply.

1. You are fluent in spoken and written Spanish and English and can hold a full, natural phone conversation with a patient or      parent in either language.

2. You have 1+ year of experience scheduling patients or coordinating patient communication in an orthodontic, dental, or other healthcare setting.

3. You have used a dental or orthodontic practice management or scheduling system to book, move, and confirm appointments (Ortho2 Edge, Open Dental, Dentrix, Curve, or similar).

4. You are warm, clear, and confident on the phone with U.S. patients.

5. You understand patient privacy and are comfortable working in a HIPAA-regulated environment.

6. You can work 8:00am to 5:00pm Pacific Time and have reliable internet, a backup connection or power plan, and a quiet workspace for calls.



Nice to Haves

1. Orthodontic office experience (braces, aligners, retainers, treatment-in-progress scheduling)

2. Hands-on experience with Ortho2 Edge

3. Experience with patient texting or communication platforms

4. A track record of reducing no-shows or filling open schedule slots

5. Experience supporting more than one office or location



What You’ll Do



1. Scheduling

    Book, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments across the practice calendar

    Keep provider schedules full and well organized

    Handle cancellations and last-minute changes and fill open slots when possible

    Schedule new patient consultations from inbound calls, texts, and web inquiries



2. Patient Engagement

    Send appointment reminders and confirmations by phone, text, and

    Follow up with patients who cancel, no-show, or fall behind on treatment visits

    Reach out to patients who are overdue for appointments and help them get back on schedule

    Respond to patient and parent questions quickly, warmly, and accurately



3. Bilingual Support

    Communicate fluently with Spanish-speaking patients and parents by phone, text, and

    Explain appointment details, what to expect at a visit, and next steps clearly in either language



4. Coordination & Documentation

    Document every patient interaction clearly in the practice management system

    Pass patient needs and concerns to the clinical team and office staff

    Follow practice workflows and communication standards across both offices

    Protect patient information at all times



How to Apply

Submit all 4 items. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. Resume: A viewable link (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.). Make sure sharing is set to “anyone with the link can view.”



2. Experience paragraph (4 to 6 sentences total): Briefly cover:

    Your patient scheduling and patient communication experience (name the type of practice)

    The scheduling or practice management software you have used

    Your experience speaking with patients in Spanish and English



3. Schedule-saving example: A short written description of one time you reduced no-shows, recovered a cancelled patient, or filled an open schedule. Please include:

    What the situation was

    What you did

    The result

  

4. Bilingual voice sample: A link to a 60 to 90 second recording (Loom, Vocaroo, or similar) of you handling this call: “A parent calls to reschedule their child’s braces adjustment because of a school conflict, and the earliest open slot is two weeks away.” Respond first in English, then repeat your response in Spanish.



Subject Line: Bilingual Ortho Scheduling Coordinator: [Your Full Name]

title: Marketing Assistant
On-Call Personal & Property Assistant - UK Property Business (ad hoc, UK working hours)
description:
ABOUT US

We're a small, family-run UK property business that lets houses, rooms and studios. The owner wants a dependable assistant for the property side and for some personal admin, which is why this is a combined personal and property assistant role. He has other businesses too, but they won't be your focus. He has worked with remote assistants for several years.



HOW WE WORK: LED BY AI, POWERED BY A PERSON

AI agents already run much of our day-to-day work. They triage the inboxes, draft and send
s and WhatsApp messages (sometimes on your behalf, sometimes on their own account), track tasks and follow set routines for lettings and property management. You'll work mainly with two of these agents. They'll brief you, tell you what needs doing and support you as you go.



What they can't replace is a sensible, reliable person. You will be:

- The eyes and brain. Bring common sense to what the AI is doing. Spot anything that looks wrong or unusual, help it get past blockers, and check that it's following its routines and doing its repeat work reliably.

- The hands. Make and take phone calls, make judgement calls, and do the things a person can do more easily, quickly or better, including the times when a personal, human touch matters.



AI will assist and lead the work, but the right person will always be an important part of how we operate. You don't need to be a UK property expert. You do need to be dependable and switched on, and comfortable working with AI tools.



WHEN WE NEED YOU

We need you most during UK working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm UK time (5pm-2am Philippine time in UK winter). Ideally you're also reasonably responsive outside those hours. Weekend work is occasional, mainly messages with the owner, a viewing day, a tenant issue, or helping with his personal plans. You'll usually know in advance when you need to be especially available. Work comes in short bursts of ad hoc tasks, not long fixed shifts.



The most important thing is being reliably available and responsive. When something comes up during your agreed hours, we need you to see it on WhatsApp and act on it quickly, usually within 30 minutes. We don't get many incoming calls, but sometimes you'll need to keep your work phone close. For example, during a block of viewings someone may have a last-minute question or an access problem, and you'll call them to sort it out.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- A work phone number on a VoIP app that rings on both your phone and your computer. You'll use it to call UK numbers and to take incoming calls. We pay for the line.

- WhatsApp, which we use heavily for messaging.

- Google Workspace, and AI agents to brief you and draft for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Phone calls to UK numbers: contractors such as plumbers, electricians and other trades, letting agents, suppliers, utility companies, councils (when approved) and tenants. You'll get a short brief before each call and report back afterwards on what was agreed.

- Incoming calls on the work number when needed, such as during viewings.

- Messaging tenants, applicants and contractors by WhatsApp and
, following our scripts and rules.

- Arranging contractors and viewings: booking slots, confirming access and attendance, and chasing.

- Following up: making sure what was promised actually happens (repairs, quotes, documents, payments), and flagging it when it doesn't.

- Overseeing the AI: checking its drafts, lists and records, making sure it keeps to its routines, and speaking up when something looks off.

- Light admin: filing and simple updates in Google Sheets and Docs.

- Personal assistant tasks for the owner: booking appointments, calling companies on his behalf, chasing deliveries and refunds, and other everyday admin.



REQUIREMENTS

- Good spoken English. You'll need to be clear and confident on UK phone calls and able to follow UK accents.

- Good written English for messages and notes (the AI agents help with drafting).

- Quick to respond on WhatsApp during your agreed hours, and able to take a call when needed.

- Reliable internet with a backup for power or internet cuts (e.g. mobile data, UPS or inverter), a quiet place to take calls, a headset, and a smartphone and computer that can run a VoIP app.

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and happy to work alongside AI tools.

- Common sense, and the confidence to flag things that don't look right.

- Discreet and trustworthy, because you'll handle people's personal information.

- Organised, with clear notes recording who said what, when, and any dates and amounts.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience in UK property or lettings, real estate VA work, or customer service.

- Experience making calls to UK or US businesses.

- Experience with OpenRent, SpareRoom, Rightmove or similar.

- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or similar at work.



PAY AND START

You'll be paid by the hour, at your agreed rate, for the work you do. There's no retainer and no minimum hours. You'll keep a simple log of your tasks and time and bill from it. We'd prefer an immediate start, but we can be flexible.



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip any step won't be considered.

1. Subject line: start it with KETTLE ON - [your first name] so we know you've read this post.

2. Availability: list the hours you're usually free for ad hoc tasks, in UK time, Monday to Sunday, and confirm whether you can cover Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm UK time. Tell us whether you have another job, and what its hours are.

3. Voice recording (required, 1-2 minutes): send a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) to a natural recording that isn't read from a script. In it: (a) introduce yourself and say when you're available in UK time; and (b) act out this call in your own words. You're phoning a plumber for a landlord client about a leaking kitchen tap at one of his rental flats. Find out their earliest availability this week and their call-out charge, and explain that the tenant can give access after 2pm.

4. Short written answers, in your own words:

(a) Tell us about a time you had to chase someone who kept missing a deadline. What did you do?

(b) Tell us about a time you spotted a mistake someone else (or a tool) had made. What did you do about it?

(c) What's your typical response time on WhatsApp during your available hours, and how would you handle an incoming work call while you're busy with something else?

(d) What internet speed do you have, and what's your backup if the power or internet goes down?

(e) What is your expected rate (US$ per hour)?

5. Your CV.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short paid test task and a 20-minute call that includes a quick phone role-play.



Individuals only. No agencies or automation services, please.

# NOW HIRING: Lead Conversion & Booking Virtual Assistant

**HQR Junk Removal | Remote Position**



HQR Junk Removal is a family-owned junk removal company serving Collin County, Dallas, and surrounding areas in Texas.



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, results-driven **Virtual Assistant specializing in customer service, sales, lead conversion, and appointment booking.**



**This is NOT a basic administrative assistant position.**



We need someone who can confidently speak with customers, convert inquiries into booked appointments, follow up consistently, and take ownership of our lead management process.



### Key Responsibilities



**Customer Service & Appointment Booking**

- Answer incoming phone calls from Google and GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Respond professionally to customer inquiries via phone, text, and
.

- Qualify leads and schedule estimates and junk removal appointments using Jobber.

- Coordinate scheduling and appointment confirmations.

- Ensure missed calls and messages receive prompt follow-up.



**Sales & Lead Conversion**

- Make outbound calls to new leads and prospective customers.

- Follow up with customers who have received estimates but have not booked.

- Re-engage past leads and customers.

- Overcome common customer objections and confidently ask for the booking.

- Help improve our lead-to-customer conversion rate.



**CRM & Lead Tracking**

- Manage and organize leads inside GoHighLevel.

- Keep customer information and appointment details accurate in Jobber.

- Track lead sources, appointments, estimates, bookings, and closed sales.

- Maintain a clear, organized sales pipeline.

- Provide daily and weekly performance reports.



**Marketing & Administrative Support**

- Create and schedule social media posts.

- Respond to social media inquiries.

- Assist with Google review requests and customer follow-ups.

- Organize customer communications, schedules, and administrative tasks.

- Identify opportunities to improve company operations.



### Qualifications



- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, natural, easily understood American English communication.

- Strong phone communication, customer service, and sales skills.

- Experience converting leads into appointments or paying customers.

- Experience with GoHighLevel and Jobber strongly preferred.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Comfortable making outbound sales and follow-up calls.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

- Reliable internet connection and quiet professional workspace.

- Ability to work during U.S. Central Time business hours.

- Experience in home services, junk removal, cleaning, moving, HVAC, or similar industries is a plus.



### What We're Looking For



We are NOT looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.



We want someone who:

- Takes initiative and identifies problems before they escalate.

- Is confident speaking with American customers.

- Understands that answering the phone is only the beginning — the goal is converting leads into booked jobs.

- Is persistent with follow-ups while remaining professional.

- Can organize systems, track performance, and recommend improvements.

- Is dependable, accountable, and results-oriented.



### REQUIRED APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To be considered, applicants MUST complete BOTH requirements:



**1. Submit a short video introduction (1–2 minutes)** explaining:

- Who you are and your relevant experience.

- Your experience with customer service, sales, and appointment booking.

- Your experience using GoHighLevel, Jobber, or similar software.

- How you would improve lead conversion for a junk removal business.



**2. Include the exact words "NEXT LEVEL" in your application
.**



**Applications that do not include BOTH the video introduction and the words "NEXT LEVEL" will be automatically disqualified.**



We are looking for someone who follows instructions, communicates confidently, solves problems, and produces measurable results.



**If you are ready to take ownership of our booking and lead conversion process, we encourage you to apply.**

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Payment: Monthly in USD for approved hours worked. Payment method, invoicing, approval process, and payment date will be specified in the freelance agreement.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management



Performance will be reviewed through regular check-ins and a weekly scorecard covering:

Content packages completed and approved.

Delivery timeliness and quality.

CRM accuracy and follow-up completion.

Prospecting and qualified opportunities.

Meetings, proposals, closed customers, and revenue where available.

Automation reliability, reporting, communication, ownership, and blocker resolution.

Targets and priorities may be reviewed as business conditions and available resources change. Material changes to working hours, compensation, or contractual obligations must be agreed through the contract process.



Confidentiality, Data Security, and Compliance

Protect company, client, prospect, and customer information. Use authorized accounts and tools, follow applicable laws and platform policies, and never disclose confidential information to unauthorized parties or upload it to unapproved AI services. title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

description:

What you'll do

How we work

- Simple task board: Assigned → In Progress → Ready for Review → Approved → Completed.

- Each deliverable has an accessible link and objective acceptance criteria.

- No long daily reports.

- Success = finished MP4s, organized editable source files, and usable production assets delivered on schedule. No unfinished clips presented as completed videos.



Reliability — non-negotiable

Reliability is the job. Read this before you apply:

- Internet speed test required: include a screenshot of your internet speed test (download, upload, ping) taken in the last 7 days. Reliable high-speed internet is required — proposed minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload.

- No overtime unless reviewed: no overtime hours unless reviewed and approved in advance. Do not work extra hours and bill them without approval.

3. Weekly availability (days/hours, timezone).

4. One example of a production problem you solved independently — what broke, what you tried, how it ended.

5. Your internet speed test screenshot (last 7 days) and your backup plan for power/internet outages.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a small paid skills test (same scope, deadline, and pay for all candidates): produce one finished 15–30-second mortgage reel from supplied materials, with captions, visual movement, clean editing, and correct formatting. Deliver MP4 + editable sources.

title: onboarding specialists - eclinical Works  Experience Required
description:
Job Posting: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding & Training Specialist



Position Title: eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist

Department: Healthcare Operations / Clinical Information Systems

Employment Type: Full-Time Remote with offsite support.



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced eClinicalWorks (eCW) Onboarding and Training Specialist to support the implementation, configuration, onboarding, and ongoing training of clinical and administrative personnel across a growing network of physician practices and outpatient healthcare facilities.



The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience with the eClinicalWorks Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Practice Management (PM) platforms, including provider onboarding, clinical workflow development, staff training, system optimization, and troubleshooting.



This position requires an individual who can independently manage onboarding activities, train physicians and staff, identify workflow inefficiencies, and ensure consistent and effective utilization of eClinicalWorks across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Provider and Staff Onboarding



* Coordinate and manage eClinicalWorks onboarding for newly hired physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, medical assistants, and administrative staff.

* Configure user accounts, role-based permissions, provider profiles, and appropriate system access in coordination with authorized system administrators.

* Assist with provider scheduling templates, appointment types, clinical documentation templates, and practice-specific workflows.

* Ensure new employees receive appropriate training before independently using the EHR.

* Develop standardized onboarding checklists and training completion requirements.

* Support onboarding of newly acquired or established practices transitioning to eClinicalWorks.



2. eClinicalWorks Training and Education



* Conduct individual and group training sessions for physicians, clinical staff, and administrative personnel.

* Provide comprehensive instruction on eClinicalWorks functionality, including:

    * Patient registration and demographics

    * Appointment scheduling and provider calendars

    * Clinical documentation and progress notes

    * Electronic prescribing (eRx)

    * Medication reconciliation

    * Laboratory and diagnostic imaging orders

    * Referral management

    * Clinical templates and order sets

    * Patient portal and communication workflows

    * Billing, charge capture, and practice management

    * Task management, telephone encounters, and clinical messaging

* Develop training manuals, quick-reference guides, instructional videos, and competency assessments.

* Provide refresher training following software updates, workflow changes, or identified performance deficiencies.



3. Workflow Development and Optimization



* Evaluate existing clinical and administrative workflows to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

* Collaborate with physicians, clinical leadership, and operations teams to standardize workflows across multiple practice locations.

* Assist in developing and optimizing documentation templates, clinical protocols, order sets, and specialty-specific workflows.

* Support improvements in documentation accuracy, charge capture, and revenue cycle processes.

* Recommend system configuration changes to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* Ensure eClinicalWorks workflows support regulatory requirements and organizational policies.



4. Implementation and System Support



* Participate in new practice implementations, EHR deployments, and system upgrades.

* Assist with practice setup, testing, workflow validation, and go-live readiness.

* Provide hands-on support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

* Troubleshoot common user issues involving documentation, scheduling, prescriptions, orders, and other EHR functions.

* Escalate technical problems to eClinicalWorks support or internal IT personnel when appropriate.

* Track reported issues, corrective actions, and resolution status.

* Maintain standardized system configuration and training documentation.



5. Compliance and Quality Assurance



* Train personnel on accurate clinical documentation and proper use of electronic health records.

* Promote compliance with HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and organizational information security requirements.

* Support appropriate documentation, coding, and billing workflows.

* Monitor completion of required onboarding and system competency assessments.

* Identify recurring user errors and implement corrective education.

* Collaborate with clinical leadership to support documentation quality and operational performance.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience using eClinicalWorks, preferably in implementation, onboarding, training, or EHR administration.

* Demonstrated experience training physicians, clinical staff, and administrative teams.

* Strong understanding of eClinicalWorks EHR and Practice Management functionality.

* Experience configuring clinical workflows, scheduling templates, provider profiles, and user permissions.

* Knowledge of medical office operations, patient registration, clinical documentation, and billing workflows.

* Ability to troubleshoot application-related issues and communicate effectively with technical support teams.

* Strong organizational, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and onboarding schedules simultaneously.

* Proficiency in developing training materials, standard operating procedures, and competency assessments.

* Ability to work independently in a remote or multisite healthcare environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience as an eClinicalWorks Trainer, Implementation Specialist, Application Specialist, or EHR Administrator.

* Formal eClinicalWorks training or certification, if available and applicable.

* Experience supporting multiple medical practices or multispecialty healthcare organizations.

* Familiarity with specialty-specific clinical workflows, including orthopedics, pain management, spine, physical medicine, and outpatient surgery.

* Experience with eClinicalWorks reporting, population health tools, and operational dashboards.

* Knowledge of revenue cycle management, charge capture, and claims workflows.

* Experience supporting EHR conversions, practice acquisitions, or multisite implementations.

* Clinical background as a Registered Nurse, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Medical Assistant, or other healthcare professional is beneficial but not required.



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be expected to:



1. Independently coordinate and complete provider and employee EHR onboarding.

2. Deliver effective training that prepares employees to perform assigned responsibilities within eClinicalWorks.

3. Maintain accurate training records and onboarding documentation.

4. Reduce recurring system-related errors through targeted education.

5. Support consistent EHR workflows across all assigned locations.

6. Respond promptly to training requests and application support issues.

7. Identify opportunities to improve provider productivity, clinical documentation, and operational efficiency.

8. Provide regular progress reports regarding onboarding completion, training activities, and outstanding issues.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for a hands-on eClinicalWorks expert, not simply an individual who has used the software in a clinical or administrative role.



The successful candidate must understand how eClinicalWorks is configured, how physicians and staff use the platform, and how to train personnel to use the system accurately and efficiently.



This role requires exceptional troubleshooting skills, independent problem-solving, and the ability to translate complex EHR functions into clear, practical instructions for healthcare professionals.



Application Requirements



Applicants should submit a current resume highlighting their direct eClinicalWorks experience, including:



* Number of years working with eClinicalWorks.

* Specific eClinicalWorks modules and functionality supported.

* Experience onboarding providers and clinical staff.

* Experience developing and delivering EHR training.

* Number and types of medical practices supported.

* Experience with implementation, system configuration, and workflow optimization.

* Availability, preferred work arrangement, and compensation expectations.



Important: Direct, hands-on eClinicalWorks experience is required. General EHR experience with Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, or other platforms alone will not satisfy this requirement.

title: Conservation Specialist
description:
NOW HIRING: Policy Conservation Specialist – Remote (Work From Home)



**Position:** Policy Conservation & Customer Retention Specialist  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Schedule:** U.S. Business Hours (Eastern Time)   

**Industry:** Customer Service / Policy Retention



Job Description



We are looking for motivated, professional, and persuasive individuals to join our team as **Policy Conservation Specialists**.



In this role, you will contact existing and former policyholders whose coverage has lapsed or is at risk of cancellation. Your primary responsibility will be to reconnect with these individuals, understand their concerns, and help guide them through the process of restoring their coverage.



We are looking for individuals who are comfortable making outbound calls, handling objections, and building relationships with customers.



Key Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to policyholders with lapsed or inactive coverage.

- Educate customers about the importance of maintaining their coverage.

- Identify reasons for missed payments, cancellations, or lapses.

- Address concerns and objections professionally.

- Encourage interested customers to explore reinstating their policies.

- Schedule appointments with authorized representatives to assist with policy reinstatement.

- Follow up with customers who express interest but are not ready to move forward.

- Maintain accurate call notes and update customer records.

- Meet daily and weekly performance expectations.



Qualifications



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Previous experience in outbound calling, customer retention, collections, appointment setting, or sales is preferred.

- Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.

- Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based customers.

- Ability to remain professional when dealing with frustrated or hesitant customers.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

- Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection.

- Ability to work independently and meet performance goals.



**Experience with insurance policy retention, reinstatement, or conservation is a major advantage.**



What We're Looking For



We want someone who doesn't simply make calls but understands how to turn a conversation into an opportunity.



The ideal candidate is persistent without being pushy, knows how to build trust, and understands the importance of following up.



**Your success will be measured by your ability to reconnect with customers, generate qualified reinstatement appointments, and contribute to successful policy recoveries.**



 How to Apply



To be considered, please submit:



1. Your updated resume.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your relevant experience.

3. A brief description of your experience with customer retention, collections, outbound sales, or appointment setting.

4. Your availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours.



**Please include "CONSERVATION SPECIALIST" in the subject line of your application.**



We are looking for dependable, results-driven individuals interested in a long-term opportunity.

title: Door-to-Door Sales Representative
description:
On-site field sales job, anywhere in the Philippines. You work in your own city or province. Not home based.



You hand out leaflets, talk to people face to face, and sign them up to our paid programme on the spot using your own QR code. You get a fixed base salary every week, plus a bonus for every approved sign-up.



What you will do every day



Hand out leaflets in busy places: malls, markets, transport terminals, universities, job fairs, barangay events, and door to door where allowed.

Stop people, explain the programme in under a minute, and answer their questions.

Sign interested people up on their own phone with your QR code. It takes about 5 minutes.

Follow up by text or Messenger with anyone who started but did not finish.

Send a short report every evening: where you were, how many people you spoke to, how many sign-ups.



Pay



Base salary: PHP 30,000 per month, paid weekly, whatever your numbers are.

Sign-up bonus: PHP 1,000 for every approved sign-up you bring in. No cap.

Monthly bonus: PHP 550 every month for each person you signed up who stays active.

Transport allowance: PHP 3,000 per month.

Leaflets, ID lanyard and stand materials are provided. You never pay for anything. Training is paid.



What you can earn in a month (examples, not a promise)



10 approved sign-ups a week (40 a month): PHP 33,000 base and transport + PHP 40,000 bonuses = PHP 73,000

25 approved sign-ups a week (100 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 100,000 = PHP 133,000

50 approved sign-ups a week (200 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 200,000 = PHP 233,000

On top of that, the monthly bonus keeps adding up: 100 people you signed up who are still active = an extra PHP 55,000 every month.



Tracking

You get your own QR code and link. Every sign-up through it is credited to you automatically, and you can see your numbers.



Hours

Monday to Friday, about 8 hours a day, daytime, plus some paid weekend events.



Requirements



Lives anywhere in the Philippines and can travel around your own city or province

Clear spoken English and Filipino or your local language

Comfortable approaching strangers all day

Smartphone with mobile data

Promo, field sales, events, door-to-door or campus experience is a plus

Reliable, honest, and happy to report your numbers every day



Rules

Never ask anyone for a password, ID, bank details or money, and never promise anyone a fixed income.



How to apply



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph.

title: Part-Time Fight Footage Tagger (Boxing, Muay Thai), Paid Per Round, Long-Term Role
description:
Get paid to watch fights the way a coach does: every punch, kick, knee and elbow, nothing missed.



ABOUT US

We're a small UK-based combat sports analytics company. Coaches send us fight footage from Muay Thai, kickboxing, boxing and MMA, and we turn every strike into data they use to prepare their fighters: what landed, what didn't, and the patterns behind it. The analysis is only as good as the tagging underneath it, and that's the job.



Please read this ad to the end. There's a specific instruction for applying.



IMPORTANT: WE'RE HIRING FOR THE LONG TERM

We're building a small, trained team, not a crowd. Training someone properly takes weeks, so we want people who will stay for years, and we'd rather pay well and keep one good tagger than keep replacing people. If you're looking for something to fill a few months, this isn't the right fit.



THE ROLE

You'll watch fight footage one round at a time and log every strike into a fixed template, one row per strike: who threw it, what it was, what it targeted, whether it landed, was blocked, missed or was a feint, how the opponent reacted, distance and ring position.



We have a written standard that tells you exactly how to tag each field. Every field gets filled in. When the footage doesn't clearly show the answer, you enter your best guess and mark it as unsure in the comments. An honest "unsure" is never held against you. A guess that isn't marked as one is the most serious error in this job, and that rule matters more than speed.



Your first month is a learning period. You'll work only on publicly broadcast fights, every round you submit gets a full review, and we'll send written feedback. Once your accuracy is consistent, you move onto private footage from our coach clients, with more volume and a higher rate.



We're a growing business, so we'll be honest about volume: expect around 5 to 10 rounds a week at the start, growing as our client base grows. The people who join now are the ones who grow with it.



PAY

- $9 (approx 515 PHP) per round during training and on broadcast fights

- $10.50 per round once you move onto client footage

- +$1 per round bonus for any month you hit our accuracy target on the monthly check round



Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal. A round takes about 1.5 to 2 hours once you know the system, and longer while you're learning. Experienced taggers get faster, so the better you get, the more you earn per hour. Rounds that don't meet the standard come back to you for correction before payment.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Real striking knowledge beyond boxing. You train, used to train, coach, or have watched Muay Thai or kickboxing closely for years. You can tell a feint from a missed shot without thinking about it.

- Comfort reading the clinch: knees, elbows and short strikes in close.

- Patience with careful, repetitive work. One round can mean 100 or more rows, each one checked.

- Honesty about uncertainty. Knowing when you can't tell, and saying so, is a skill here.

- Someone who notices things and says so. If our standard is unclear or wrong somewhere, we want to hear it.

- Good written English, a laptop or desktop, and a stable internet connection.

- Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement before working on client footage.



WHAT THIS ISN'T

General data entry or annotation work. Video editing. Anything you can do with the fight on in the background. If you don't enjoy watching fights closely, this job will be miserable.



TO APPLY

Instead of a greeting, start your message with your full name and then the words "southpaw jab". Applications without it won't be read.



Then tell us:

1. What is your connection to combat sports? Be specific: which disciplines, training, competing, coaching, or which fighters you've studied.

2. What is the difference between a cross and an overhand?

3. In Muay Thai, what is the difference between checking a teep and a round house kick?

4. If you're watching a round and can't tell whether a strike landed or was blocked, what should you do?



HIRING PROCESS

1. Short practical test (about 15 minutes): you watch a short clip and send us a voice note describing each strike in a set format.

2. Video call: we walk you through our system and answer your questions.

3. Paid test round: you tag one full round using our standard, paid in full whether or not you're selected.

4. Paid trial of 5 rounds, then ongoing work.

- Custom CRM. Every lead in one place, built around how they sell, with follow-up texts,
s and tasks going out on a schedule.

- Lead engine. Finds businesses that look like their best customers and puts them in the CRM for their team to call.

- Reputation engine. Asks every finished job for a review and drafts a reply to each new one.

- Reporting dashboard. Leads, calls, booked jobs and revenue on one screen, by location and by source.

- Custom AI tools. Quote builders, intake forms, document tools and assistants trained on their own files.

- Website and search. The website and the Google, Google Maps and AI-answer work that bring the leads in. We can also run their Google, Local Services and
 ads on their own account.



Everything we do is remote.



What you offer on the call: a free 30-minute call with us about how leads reach them now and where they go missing. That's all you're booking.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY



1. Log in to our CRM and clock in. We give you the login. It runs in Chrome.

2. Open your call list. Every lead is already researched for you. You'll see why they're a good fit, where they're likely losing leads (with the proof), an opener, a 20-second pitch, scripts for the front desk, the owner and voi
, and answers to common objections.

3. Call from the CRM. It dials from our U.S. business number, right in your browser.

4. Get past the front desk, reach the owner or manager, and ask for the free 30-minute call.

5. When they say yes, book the meeting on our calendar with the "Book a meeting" button. They get a Google Meet invite by
.

6. After every call, click the result and write a short note. If they ask you to call back, set the callback for the time they gave.

7. Do your callbacks and follow-ups first, then new calls.

8. Clock out at the end of your shift.



THREE RULES



- Never quote a price. If they ask, say it depends on what we find and we'll cover it on the call.

- Never promise results, like more leads, more revenue or #1 on Google. Talk about what the system does.

- Only say what's in their research. If you're not sure, ask a question instead. And never say someone will come to their office. Everything we do is remote.



PAY



- You start at $4 an hour with a short paid trial.

- Your hourly rate goes up to $10 an hour based on results, like meetings booked and meetings that show up.

- Bonus: when we close a deal with a lead you booked, you get a bonus.

- Commission: when you close a deal yourself, you earn commission. Commission starts later on, or sooner if you go the extra mile and find your own leads.

- We'll go over the exact amounts on our call.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Clear spoken English. You'll be talking to U.S. business owners all day.

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience. Calling businesses (B2B) is a big plus. If you're new to cold calling but your English is very clear, you can still apply.

- A computer with Chrome, a noise-canceling headset and a quiet room.

- Fast, stable internet with a backup, like a hotspot or a second line.

- You can work 4 to 6 hours a day, Monday to Friday, starting at one of the times above.



HOW TO APPLY



Send all of this. Applications missing any part won't be read.



1. Put the words GOOGLE MAPS at the start of your subject line, so we know you read the whole post.

2. Your name, your hourly rate, your start time (10 AM, 12 PM or 2 PM Pacific), and how many hours a day you can work (4 to 6).

3. Your cold calling or appointment setting experience. Who did you call, what did you offer, and about how many meetings did you book a week?

4. A speed test link from speedtest.net.

5. Your resume.

6. A 60-second voice recording made for this job. Tell us about yourself and why you'd be good at this. Please send a 
 link, not a Loom video or a file.

7. One real U.S. business from the list above that you would call, and where you think they're losing leads. Two sentences is enough.



We're hiring one person, so agencies and teams, please don't apply.



Thanks!

title: Experienced Appointment Setter – U.S. Service BusinessesExperienced Appointment Setter – U.S. Service Businesses
description:
# Experienced Appointment Setter – U.S. Service Businesses



**Company:** BrioDigital  

**Website:** 
  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Full-Time, Long-Term  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (40 hours per week)  

**Compensation:** Hourly pay based on experience and qualifications, plus additional commission opportunities  

**Positions Available:** Multiple



## About BrioDigital



BrioDigital is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency helping businesses attract more customers, improve their online visibility, generate leads, and grow their revenue.



Our services include website development, search engine optimization (SEO), digital advertising, and other marketing solutions.



We are seeking **experienced, professional appointment setters** to contact U.S. businesses that provide products and services directly to consumers.



Our target industries include:



- Attorneys and law firms

- General contractors and home improvement companies

- Roofing, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors

- Landscaping and other home-service businesses

- Dental practices and other professional service providers

- Automotive repair and service businesses

- Other local businesses serving individual consumers



We want professionals who are comfortable speaking with business owners, office managers, and decision-makers.



**THIS IS AN APPOINTMENT-SETTING POSITION, NOT A SALES-CLOSING POSITION.**



Our U.S. sales representatives handle presentations, proposals, and closing sales. Your responsibility is to identify interested businesses, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments.



## Key Responsibilities



- Make professional outbound calls to U.S. service businesses.

- Contact business owners, attorneys, contractors, office managers, and other decision-makers.

- Navigate receptionists, office staff, and gatekeepers.

- Introduce BrioDigital and explain how our services help businesses attract customers.

- Ask questions to identify potential marketing needs.

- Qualify interested prospects before scheduling appointments.

- Schedule appointments for our U.S.-based sales representatives.

- Confirm appointments and follow up to reduce cancellations and no-shows.

- Maintain accurate prospect information, call notes, and appointment records in our CRM.

- Work with company-provided prospect lists and contact information.

- Research additional potential business prospects when appropriate.

- Follow company calling scripts while communicating naturally and professionally.

- Coordinate with the sales team to maintain appointment quality.



**You are not responsible for closing sales.**



## Required Qualifications



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



1. **Minimum 3 years of professional appointment-setting, outbound calling, or telemarketing experience, with proven appointment-setting results.**

2. Experience contacting business owners, managers, or other decision-makers.

3. Fluent spoken English with clear pronunciation, professional communication, and natural conversational ability.

4. Strong telephone communication and active-listening skills.

5. Proven ability to navigate gatekeepers and handle objections effectively.

6. Ability to think independently and adapt conversations rather than simply reading a script.

7. Previous experience using CRM software.

8. Ability to provide measurable appointment-setting results from previous positions.

9. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through.

10. Availability to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

11. Own computer, reliable high-speed internet connection, professional headset, and quiet workspace.



**Traditional B2B sales experience is not required.**



Experience contacting attorneys, contractors, home-service businesses, or other consumer-facing companies is particularly valuable.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience calling law firms, contractors, or local service businesses.

- Experience with digital marketing, advertising, SEO, website development, or lead-generation services.

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

- Experience researching business prospects and identifying decision-makers.

- Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI-assisted research and communication tools.



Digital marketing and ChatGPT experience are preferred, not mandatory. Training will be provided.



## What Qualifies as a Successful Appointment?



Our goal is to schedule meetings with **business owners or decision-makers who have expressed genuine interest in BrioDigital's services and agreed to meet with a sales representative.**



We value:



- Qualified prospects with a potential need for our services.

- Appointments with actual decision-makers.

- Genuine interest rather than appointments scheduled simply to meet a number.

- Strong appointment attendance and follow-through.

- Accurate CRM documentation.



We do not advertise a fixed daily call quota or weekly appointment minimum.



Performance is evaluated based on appointment quality, meeting attendance, and overall results.



## Compensation and Opportunity



BrioDigital offers:



- **Hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.**

- **Additional commission opportunities when scheduled appointments result in completed sales.**

- A permanent, long-term, full-time opportunity for qualified individuals.

- Training on BrioDigital's services, calling scripts, CRM procedures, and appointment-setting processes.

- Company-provided prospect lists and contact information.

- The opportunity to work with an established U.S. digital marketing agency.

- A professional, performance-focused working environment.



**This is not a commission-only position.**



The role includes hourly compensation, with additional opportunities to earn commissions when scheduled appointments result in completed sales.



## Training and Onboarding



BrioDigital will provide training covering:



- Our digital marketing services and how they help businesses.

- How to communicate with attorneys, contractors, and other local service providers.

- Company calling scripts and recommended approaches.

- CRM procedures and accurate activity tracking.

- Appointment qualification, scheduling, and confirmation procedures.

- Effective coordination with our U.S. sales representatives.



Applicants must already have professional appointment-setting or outbound calling experience.



Training is intended to familiarize experienced professionals with BrioDigital's services and processes.



## How to Apply — All Four Items Are Required



To be considered, submit the following:



### 1. Updated Resume



Include your previous appointment-setting, outbound calling, or telemarketing experience, employers, responsibilities, and dates of employment.



### 2. Mandatory 60-Second English Voice Recording



Record a brief introduction in English explaining:



- Who you are.

- Your previous appointment-setting experience.

- The types of businesses or customers you have contacted.

- Why you believe you are qualified for this position.



Your recording should demonstrate clear pronunciation, confidence, professionalism, and natural conversational ability.



### 3. Written Experience Summary



Provide a short written explanation covering:



- Your appointment-setting background.

- Industries and products or services you have worked with.

- Whether you have contacted attorneys, contractors, business owners, or other decision-makers.

- Your experience navigating gatekeepers and handling objections.



### 4. Measurable Appointment-Setting Results



Provide actual results from previous positions, including:



- Average number of qualified appointments scheduled per week.

- Appointment attendance or show-up rate, if available.

- Other measurable results demonstrating your appointment-setting performance.



**IMPORTANT: Applications missing any of these four required items will not be considered.**



## Interview and Selection Process



Qualified applicants selected for an interview will be required to complete a **live appointment-setting role-play**.



During the role-play, candidates will demonstrate their ability to:



- Open a professional outbound telephone conversation.

- Contact an attorney, contractor, or local service-business owner.

- Navigate a receptionist or gatekeeper.

- Communicate naturally with a business decision-maker.

- Handle objections such as "We already have a marketing company" or "We're not interested."

- Identify interest and qualify the prospect.

- Successfully request and secure an appointment.



We are looking for experienced professionals who communicate confidently, think on their feet, and represent BrioDigital professionally.



No separate calling test is required beyond the interview role-play.



## Start Date



Immediate availability is preferred. However, we are willing to wait for the right candidate with the necessary experience, communication skills, and proven results.



## Join BrioDigital



If you have a strong track record in appointment setting, communicate professionally in English, and consistently deliver qualified appointments, we encourage you to apply.



We are hiring multiple qualified candidates for permanent, long-term, full-time opportunities.

title: AI Supplements Designer
description:

That means print-ready supplement packaging and labels, and listing content for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop and Shopify. You should understand how supplement products are sold: building trust, communicating benefits and ingredients clearly, and presenting claims accurately.

Key Responsibilities: 



Supplement Packaging & Labels

Creative Asset Management

Quality Assurance & Compliance
