title: Senior Scheduling Care Coordinator (US Home Care, US Eastern Hours)
description:
We are a growing US home care company (7 offices, about 500 caregivers) hiring an experienced, full-time Senior Scheduling Care Coordinator. This is not an entry-level role. You keep every client staffed with the right caregiver for every authorized hour. Most of the day is phone, text and our scheduling system (WellSky): a caregiver calls off at 6am, a client comes home from the hospital with new hours, a family wants a different caregiver. You fix it, document it, and make sure our field care coordinator knows. Long-term role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain client schedules in WellSky against the plan of care, authorized hours and client preferences

- Fill open shifts and call-offs fast, before they become missed visits; look ahead and fix next week's gaps early

- Update schedules for hospitalizations, discharges and hour changes; tell caregivers and families what changed

- Match caregivers to clients by skills, availability, distance and fit; brief caregivers before first shifts and follow up after

- Work the team's task queue (timesheets, care logs, coverage) to close, same day

- Make sure scheduled hours match payer authorizations so billing is clean

- Answer caregivers, families and case managers by phone and text

- Take a turn on the after-hours on-call rotation



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US scheduling in home care, home health or healthcare staffing (general call center or VA work does not count)

- Experience scheduling against payer authorizations (Medicaid waiver, VA, long-term care insurance)

- Excellent spoken and written English; you are the voice our clients and caregivers hear

- Able to work full US Eastern business hours, 8:30am-5:00pm ET (night shift in the Philippines)

- Calm when three things break at once, and you close every open item

- Stable internet, backup power or internet, a quiet private workspace and a headset



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- WellSky/ClearCare, AxisCare, AlayaCare, HHAeXchange or similar home care software

- RingCentral or similar phone system



BENEFITS

- Paid twice a month in USD

- 10 paid days off per year

- 8 paid Philippine holidays (New Year's Day, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Labor Day, Independence Day, All Saints' Day, Christmas, Rizal Day); if you work one, that day is paid double

- 13th month pay

- Company laptop: buy one locally and we reimburse up to $1,000

- Long-term role with a 90-day trial period



The selected candidate will sign a confidentiality agreement, since the role works with client health information.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed)

1. Complete our short Culture Index survey here: 

2. Send a message here with the word "COVERED" as the first line and a short summary of your US home care or healthcare scheduling experience and the scheduling software you have used.

3. Attach or link a 1-2 minute voice recording: introduce yourself and explain how you would handle a caregiver calling off 30 minutes before a shift.

Finalists will complete a short paid scheduling exercise and a video interview.

title: Shopify Ecommerce Operations Coordinator
description:
Shopify Ecommerce Operations Coordinator

Part Time | Remote | $7 to $10 USD per Hour



About Hall Pass



Hall Pass LLC is a United States-based e-commerce business specializing in officially licensed collegiate apparel, custom merchandise, varsity jackets, patches, and accessories.



We operate a Shopify store, manage wholesale and custom apparel orders, coordinate with international manufacturers, and have a physical fulfillment team in Greensboro, North Carolina.



Website: www.HallPass.Shop



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and experienced Ecommerce Operations Virtual Assistant to help keep our business running smoothly. 



This is not a basic administrative assistant position. I truly prefer someone proficient with Claude.



We need someone who can independently track tasks, follow up with employees, monitor outstanding orders, manage spreadsheets, and make sure important responsibilities do not get overlooked.



Key Responsibilities



1. Shopify Order and Fulfillment Management



* Monitor unfulfilled Shopify orders.

* Maintain a tracker for orders delayed by missing inventory, production, or other issues.

* Identify missing products, sizes, and materials needed to fulfill orders.

* Follow up with employees about pending fulfillment tasks.

* Monitor order deadlines and escalate potential delays.

* Track outstanding orders until they are fulfilled.



2. Inventory and Reorder Tracking



* Collect inventory counts from our physical fulfillment team.

* Update inventory spreadsheets and records.

* Track frequently used inventory, including blank apparel, patches, and accessories.

* Identify low stock items and replenishment needs.

* Maintain an organized reorder list.

* Compare inventory availability against outstanding customer orders.

* Prepare purchasing recommendations for owner approval.



3. Employee Task Management



* Maintain a centralized task management system.

* Communicate assigned tasks and deadlines to employees.

* Follow up with employees about incomplete tasks.

* Request updates without needing reminders from management.

* Monitor outstanding assignments and escalate issues.

* Ensure tasks are documented and completed.



4. Wholesale and Custom Order Coordination



* Track incoming wholesale and bulk order inquiries.

* Maintain records of quotes, deposits, approvals, and production deadlines.

* Follow up with potential customers regarding outstanding quotes.

* Monitor custom order production timelines.

* Keep customer specifications and order details organized.

* Flag orders requiring management attention.



5. Administrative Support



* Manage agents in Claude.

* Organize Google Drive files, spreadsheets, and business documents.

* Maintain operational calendars and deadlines.

* Track important
s and outstanding communications.

* Assist with creating and maintaining standard operating procedures.

* Prepare weekly operational updates.



Required Qualifications



* Previous experience supporting an ecommerce business.

* Hands on experience using Shopify.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong Google Sheets and Google Workspace skills.

* Knowledgable Claude agent skills.

* Experience using task management software such as ClickUp, Asana, or Trello.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Comfortable communicating directly with employees and following up on assignments.

* Reliable internet connection.

* Availability for scheduled overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with apparel or fashion e-commerce brands.

* Experience with inventory management and order fulfillment; ShipStation experience preferred.

* Experience coordinating remote teams.

* Experience tracking wholesale or custom product orders.

* Experience communicating with international manufacturers.

* Ability to create operational dashboards and tracking systems.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities.



If an employee has not provided an inventory count, you follow up.



If an order cannot be fulfilled, you document the problem, identify the next step, and track it until resolved.



If a wholesale customer has not responded to a quote, you follow up according to our communication guidelines.



We want someone who keeps operations moving without requiring constant reminders from the business owner.



Work Schedule and Compensation



* 10 to 15 hours per week.

* $7 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience.

* Flexible remote schedule with required Eastern Time overlap.

* Initial 30-day paid trial.

* Opportunity for increased responsibilities and hours based on performance.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your ecommerce operations experience.

2. Your specific experience working with Shopify.

title: App Tester (Part-Time, No Coding): Sharp Eyes + Great English Wanted
description:
About us

We are a property management company in Connecticut, USA. We build our own apps for the people who keep our buildings running: maintenance and construction crews who use them on a phone, and office staff and managers who use them on a computer all day.



The people using these apps are busy and not "tech people." When a word doesn't make sense, a button is hard to find, or they can't tell whether something saved, they lose time and stop trusting the app. Right now those problems are found by our managers in meetings. We want you to find them first.



This is not a coding job

You don't need to know how apps are built. We need someone who notices when something is confusing and can explain it clearly. If you've been a virtual assistant, done customer support, or tested apps before, that experience helps.



What you will do

- Use our apps the way a new employee would, on a phone and on a computer, with test accounts for each role (field crew, inspector, dispatcher, office staff, manager).

- Follow a short task ("schedule two crew members on one job for Monday", "find the door code for this unit", "mark this repair as done") and write down every moment you hesitate.

- Look for things like:

  - Words that don't make sense. A label like "pieces," "level 2," or "hard" that doesn't tell you what it means, or two words used for the same thing.

  - Things you can't find, or didn't know you could click.

  - Colors with no meaning. Red, yellow, blue on the screen with nothing explaining them.

  - Not knowing if it worked. You clicked save or send and can't tell whether it went through, or you left a page and lost your changes.

  - Plainly wrong. You click one building and another one opens, a list is missing an item, Back takes you somewhere unexpected, a page is slow, text runs off the screen.

  - Different people seeing different things when they should see the same thing.

- Report each problem clearly: what you were trying to do, what you expected, what happened, with a screenshot or a short screen recording (Loom or similar).

- Each week, re-check the problems we said were fixed and confirm they're still fixed.

- Send a short weekly summary: what you checked, what you found, what got fixed, what still feels confusing.



Who we're looking for

- Excellent written English. You'll be judging whether our words make sense to an American worker, so this matters most.

- Patience and attention to small things.

- Honesty: if something confused you, say so, even if it seems minor.

- An Android or iPhone, a computer, and a reliable internet connection.

- Comfortable recording your screen and talking through what you see.



Hours: flexible, with 2 hours overlapping US Eastern business hours (9 AM–5 PM ET) on weekdays.



How the hiring works

1. Apply with the details below.

2. Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial: about 3 hours reviewing one of our screens, with a short written report. We pay for the trial whether or not we hire you.

3. The strongest trial gets the job.



To apply

Start your application with the words "First-time user" so we know you read the full post. Then tell us:

- Your work experience, in 3–5 sentences.

- One app or website (any one) that confused you, what confused you, and how you would fix the wording or layout.

- Which phone you would use.

- Your available hours in Philippine time.



Applications that don't start with "First-time user" won't be reviewed.

title: GoHighLevel VA – Outbound Calling, Client Follow-Up & Pipelines (US Real Estate)
description:
Up Close Inspections is a growing property inspection company in Cleveland, Ohio. We work with US homebuyers, real estate agents, and loan officers. The advertised rate is $8.50 per hour. This is a part-time, long-term independent contractor role. Assigned shifts are scheduled within Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET). We will provide your exact schedule at least one week ahead. You are expected to be available only during your assigned shifts—no availability is required outside those shifts and there is no unpaid standby. For reference, the 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET window corresponds to 10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine time during US standard time and 9:00 PM–5:00 PM during US daylight saving time; your assigned shifts are within those windows and are not necessarily the full window. All onboarding and training are paid. After screening, there will be a short paid trial.



Your main job: follow up with our past clients and cold call US real estate agents to build referral relationships, while keeping every contact correctly tagged and moving through our GoHighLevel pipelines so nothing is missed.



What you’ll do



Make outbound calls to US real estate agents and loan officers using our scripts

Follow up with past and current clients by phone, text, and

Move contacts and opportunities through GoHighLevel pipelines and log every call with clear notes

Tag every contact correctly and keep the CRM clean

Book inspections and offer add-on services (radon, sewer scope, mold, termite, water testing)

Run agent outreach campaigns, follow up on tasks, and send review requests

Follow our SOPs and call scripts



Must have



1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, opportunities, tags, smart lists, Conversations, calendars, workflows

1+ year of outbound calling to US customers (BPO, sales, or appointment setting)

Clear, easy-to-understand, friendly phone English; careful listening and accurate intake are essential. A native accent is not required.

Reply to messages within 30–60 minutes during your assigned shift

Reliable internet plus a backup connection and backup power

Quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset



Nice to have



US real estate, mortgage, or insurance experience

Spectora or other scheduling software



Why work with us



Long-term role with room to grow into full time

Bonus for agent relationships you build that turn into booked inspections

Small, supportive team with clear SOPs, scripts, and training



## How to Apply – Please Follow ALL Instructions



**Applications that do not follow every step will not be reviewed.**



**Subject Line:** GHL Pipeline Pro – [Your Name]



**1. Voice Recording (60–90 Seconds)**



Submit a consistent 60–90 second voice recording using Vocaroo or a similar platform. In your own words, briefly introduce yourself, then read the mock intake script below in a friendly, clear manner. After that, answer the unscripted prompt below as if you were speaking with the caller. We value easy-to-understand phone English, careful listening, and accurate intake; a native accent is not required.



**Mock intake script:** “Thank you for calling Up Close Inspections. This is [your name]. How can I help you today? I’d be happy to help with your inspection. May I have your name, the property address and your best callback number? Do you have an inspection deadline? I’ll check pricing and availability before confirming your appointment.”



**Unscripted prompt:** A client asks, “How much will it cost, and can you inspect tomorrow?” Assume you have not checked the price or availability. Explain that you will check before confirming; do not guess a price or promise an appointment.



**2. GoHighLevel Experience – Show Us Your Skills**



We don't just want to hear that you know GoHighLevel. **We want to see your actual experience.**



Submit a short screen-recorded video (Loom or similar) or a portfolio demonstrating your ability to work with:



- **Contact Tagging:** Organizing, segmenting, and managing contacts.

- **Pipelines:** Creating pipelines, managing opportunities, and moving leads through stages.

- **Workflows & Automations:** Building automated SMS,
, and follow-up sequences.

- **Lead Management:** Tracking conversations, scheduling follow-ups, and converting leads into customers.



You may use a demo account or previous work examples, provided no confidential client information is shown.



**3. Describe Your GHL Experience**



In 3–5 sentences, tell us about a GoHighLevel pipeline you've personally managed. Explain how you organized contacts, applied tags, built workflows, and followed up with leads.



**4. Outbound Calling Experience**



Tell us about your previous outbound calling experience, including:



- Company name and length of employment.

- Approximate number of outbound calls made daily.

- Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers or real estate professionals.



**5. Final Instruction**



End your application with the exact word **Cleveland**.



---



### What Happens Next?



Shortlisted applicants will complete the screening described above, including a short live mock call. After screening, selected candidates will be invited to a short paid trial. All onboarding, training, and trial work are paid.



We're looking for someone who combines **strong GoHighLevel technical skills, clear and friendly English communication, and a professional phone presence.**



At Up Close Inspections, we value clear communication, personal relationships, and outstanding customer service. We want someone who can represent our company confidently while helping us build lasting relationships with real estate agents and clients.

 with the subject line "HPI Marketing - [Full Name] - PIANO"

title: Part-Time Xero Bookkeeper (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Weekly — one fixed day each week

● Reconcile the bank and credit card accounts in Xero, leaving nothing unreconciled

● Code every transaction to the correct account, the correct property (via tracking categories) and critically the correct VAT rate

● Reconcile booking platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, direct/Stripe), recording gross booking income, platform commission and cleaning fees separately rather than posting only the net amount that lands in the bank

● Process supplier bills and receipts from our outsourced providers — cleaning, laundry, maintenance, management and software subscriptions

● Raise and send sales invoices for direct bookings, corporate or extended stays, and any re-charges

● Chase overdue invoices politely and keep the aged debtors list short

● Send a brief weekly update: what was done, what is outstanding, and any queries for us

Monthly

● Close the month by the [7th] working day

● Deliver the management pack: Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Aged Debtors, Aged Creditors and a simple cash summary

● Present the P&L per property as well as consolidated, so we can see which unit is performing

● Include a short written commentary — what moved, what looks unusual, what needs a decision from us. This matters to us as much as the numbers do.

● Reconcile control accounts: VAT, director’s loan, supplier balances and platform clearing accounts

● Confirm all recurring costs have landed — rent, business rates, energy, broadband, insurance and subscriptions

VAT and Making Tax Digital

This is a core part of the role, not an add-on.

● Prepare the quarterly VAT return for our review and submit it through Xero under MTD, comfortably ahead of the deadline (one calendar month and seven days after the quarter end)

● Apply the correct VAT treatment to income short-term holiday and serviced accommodation is standard-rated, unlike long-term residential letting

● Handle reverse charge VAT on commission and services invoiced from overseas platforms (for example Airbnb and Booking.com) correctly on the return

● Apply the correct input VAT rate to each cost — for example, business rates carry no VAT, domestic-rate energy may be reduced-rated, broadband and most services are standard-rated, and rent may be exempt unless the landlord has opted to tax

● Reconcile the VAT control account every month rather than only at quarter end, so surprises are caught early

● Maintain MTD-compliant digital records and digital links — no manual re-keying between systems

● Keep VAT evidence complete: a valid VAT invoice on file for every input VAT claim, chased from suppliers where missing

● Flag anything with an uncertain VAT treatment to us and our accountant rather than making an assumption

● Review, when asked, whether an alternative scheme ([standard / cash accounting / flat rate]) would suit the business better

Annual

● Prepare the year-end file and deal directly with our UK accountant’s queries

● Keep the chart of accounts, VAT rates and tracking categories tidy and consistent

Short-term rental specifics

● Reconcile each platform’s payout report to the bank — payouts arrive net of commission and often cover several bookings across a date split

● Keep the three properties cleanly separated so per-property profitability is always visible

● Split repairs and maintenance from capital improvements and furnishing costs correctly

● Track refundable damage deposits, guest refunds and chargebacks properly, including their VAT treatment

● Account for rent and other fixed property costs against the correct property and the correct period

Requirements

Essential

● Minimum 2–3 years’ hands-on bookkeeping in Xero — running the books day to day, not simply "familiar with" the software

● Demonstrable experience of bank reconciliation, raising and sending invoices, and producing monthly Profit & Loss statements

● Practical experience preparing and filing UK VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for a VAT-registered business

● Confident applying different VAT rates and knowing when VAT is not recoverable

● Experience working with UK-based clients and UK bookkeeping conventions

● Accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent practical experience

● Strong written and spoken English — you will
 suppliers and our accountant directly

● Confident in Excel or Google Sheets

● Reliable internet with a backup connection

● Genuine attention to detail — you notice when a figure looks wrong

Desirable

● Xero Advisor certification

● Experience with short-term rentals, serviced accommodation, Airbnb or hospitality clients

● Experience reconciling payment platform payouts (Airbnb, Booking.com, Stripe, PayPal)

● Familiarity with reverse charge VAT and cross-border service invoices

● Multi-property or multi-entity bookkeeping

title: Operations Assistant To The Founders
description:
OPERATIONS ASSISTANT TO THE FOUNDERS



Please read this whole page before you apply.



A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDERS

We run sales funnels and
 ads, and we are scaling hard. Today we're live in three markets: the UK, Italy and Israel. Soon we will test six new funnels per market, every single day. That's 18 funnels a day.



And that's only the start. Our systems are proven, and we're now pushing on to 10 different markets.



We don't do that with a big team. We do it with AI systems we built ourselves. We believe AI is the future: companies that don't operate AI-first will be beaten by companies that do. We intend to be the second kind.



But AI isn't perfect. Pages break. Ads launch with mistakes. Customer
s get answered badly. Someone has to keep an eye on all of it, catch what's wrong, and make sure it gets fixed. We're looking for that someone: our right hand.



WHY THIS JOB IS DIFFERENT

You won't sit in one department. You'll work directly with the founders and oversee three departments at once. Every day you'll cover the same responsibilities: customer service, funnels and ads. You'll see the whole business, not one small corner of it.



You're joining at the right moment. Every new market we open means more responsibility, more to learn, and more to earn for the people who are already here.



We will hire more people over time, but our goal is to stay as lean as possible. A small team moves faster, works smarter and costs less. Fewer people means more profit per person, and that's exactly why we can pay the people who grow with us far more than they would earn elsewhere.



You don't join us for an easy job. You join because you want to challenge yourself, find out what you're capable of, and grow. You'll learn more here in one year than you would anywhere else in five.



We are not a family. Companies that tell you that aren't being honest. Think of us as a small, dedicated team that plays to win. You work here because you enjoy doing your best work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Customer service: check and handle customer
s, and spot issues that keep coming back

- Funnels: check new pages, copy and checkouts before and after they go live

- Ads: monitor ad launches and catch problems before they cost money

- Spot what's broken or weak, flag it or fix it, and follow up until it's solved

- Work 1-on-1 with the founders from day one, and stay close to us as we grow



You don't need to create anything yourself. Our systems do the creating. Your job is to check, catch and follow through.



HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER

Overseeing several departments at once only works with a good routine. In your first weeks we'll sit down with you and build a working rhythm together: what you check every day, what you check every week, and how you report back to us. You won't have to figure that out alone.



HOW IT STARTS

- A paid trial month at $5/hour, part-time

- On day one you get clear goals and KPIs for that month

- Hit them, and we continue together, moving towards full-time with performance-based pay

- Don't hit them, and we part ways. No hard feelings, no drama

We won't hold your hand. The best people always find their own way, or tell us early when they're stuck.



WORKING HOURS

You work remotely, with at least 4 hours of overlap with European working hours each day.



WHAT WE VALUE

- Thinking for yourself. Don't just accept an idea because someone said it. Reason it through.

- Saying what you think. If something looks wrong, say so. Even to us.

- Ownership. A mistake you catch and fix is worth more than ten tasks done carelessly.

- Saying no. Not every idea is worth doing. Focus wins.

- The truth. What's real wins, not what sounds good.



WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

- Formal communication. Be direct, be quick, be yourself.

- Years of experience. We care about how sharp you are and how fast you learn.

- Office politics. We're here to perform together, not to gossip.



WHO YOU ARE

- Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

- You notice when something "looks off", and you don't leave it there

- You're curious about many areas of a business and want to learn across all of them

- You love working with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets; experience with customer service, Shopify,
 Ads or funnels is a big plus



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "18 funnels a day" so we know you read this.

Then, in a few sentences: tell us about a time you caught a mistake that others missed.

Applications without this will not be read.



Is this you? Apply.

title: On-ground Sign-up Representative: Work in Your Own City (Philippines)
description:
On-site field sales job, anywhere in the Philippines. You work in your own city or province. Not home based.



You hand out leaflets, talk to people face to face, and sign them up to our paid programme on the spot using your own QR code. You get a fixed base salary every week, plus a bonus for every approved sign-up.



What you will do every day



Hand out leaflets in busy places: malls, markets, transport terminals, universities, job fairs, barangay events, and door to door where allowed.

Stop people, explain the programme in under a minute, and answer their questions.

Sign interested people up on their own phone with your QR code. It takes about 5 minutes.

Follow up by text or Messenger with anyone who started but did not finish.

Send a short report every evening: where you were, how many people you spoke to, how many sign-ups.



Pay



Base salary: PHP 30,000 per month, paid weekly, whatever your numbers are.

Sign-up bonus: PHP 1,000 for every approved sign-up you bring in. No cap.

Monthly bonus: PHP 550 every month for each person you signed up who stays active.

Transport allowance: PHP 3,000 per month.

Leaflets, ID lanyard and stand materials are provided. You never pay for anything. Training is paid.



What you can earn in a month (examples, not a promise)



10 approved sign-ups a week (40 a month): PHP 33,000 base and transport + PHP 40,000 bonuses = PHP 73,000

25 approved sign-ups a week (100 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 100,000 = PHP 133,000

50 approved sign-ups a week (200 a month): PHP 33,000 + PHP 200,000 = PHP 233,000

On top of that, the monthly bonus keeps adding up: 100 people you signed up who are still active = an extra PHP 55,000 every month.



Tracking

You get your own QR code and link. Every sign-up through it is credited to you automatically, and you can see your numbers.



Hours

Monday to Friday, about 8 hours a day, daytime, plus some paid weekend events.



Requirements



Lives anywhere in the Philippines and can travel around your own city or province

Clear spoken English and Filipino or your local language

Comfortable approaching strangers all day

Smartphone with mobile data

Promo, field sales, events, door-to-door or campus experience is a plus

Reliable, honest, and happy to report your numbers every day



Rules

Never ask anyone for a password, ID, bank details or money, and never promise anyone a fixed income.



How to apply



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph.

20 hours/week, generally across Monday–Friday. Most work is flexible, with a consistent two-hour overlap within 8 a.m.–noon America/Chicago; agree the exact window before starting. Chicago observes daylight saving time, so Philippine overlap changes seasonally. This is not 24/7 on-call work. Daily updates should cover completed work, next steps, blockers, and PR links.



PAY AND SELECTION

US$1,000/month for the stated part-time hours. We prioritize a capable developer in a focused part-time role, not senior full-time coverage at a bargain salary. Hours or pay may grow with responsibilities, but no increase is guaranteed.

title: Shopify Customer Support Specialist (Gorgias)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our team! As the voice of our brand, you’ll help our customers with orders, shipping, returns and refunds, and find solutions that balance customer satisfaction with business needs.



We want 2+ years experience in Shopify Store
 CS support. The ideal candidate has prior experience in Shopify, Gorgias and supplier communication daily. Bonus points if experience with UK customers and pet/home-goods brands.



### Who are we?



We’re dedicated to making life easier for pet owners and busy mums, with products designed to keep homes comfortable, clean and stylish. Since our 2025 launch, we’ve grown rapidly through viral digital marketing, building a passionate community of customers across the US and UK.



We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous improvement, and customer support is a big part of why people keep coming back. We’re excited to bring on a support specialist who’ll play a real role in scaling the brand.



### What is our culture like and who is a good fit?



Culture-fit is our #1 hiring factor. We have a genuine will-to-win, and no task is beneath us if it helps a customer. We live by these values:



- Think on your feet: You make good calls under pressure.

- Bring solutions, not just questions: Come with a recommendation and your reasoning.

- Own it: If a problem lands with you, you see it through.

- Quick, never sloppy: Fast replies that are still accurate and kind.

- Better every day: Every problem is a chance to improve.



You’re a great fit if you follow instructions carefully, stay calm with angry customers, and always think about how to solve the problem in front of you. When a case falls outside our policy, you check with us and bring your own recommendation. You’ll work directly with the founder, with no politics or red tape. If you want a job where you just follow a script, this isn’t it. If you want to be trusted, challenged and grow with a fast-moving company, you’ve come to the right place.



### Key Objectives



* Keep
 inboxes under control with fast, helpful replies

* Resolve
 tickets within our policies, flag with suggestion for unusual cases

* Bring down refunds and chargebacks through clear, kind communication

* Flag repeated customer problems and help improve our templates and processes



### Requirements



* Available Mon-Sat

* Excellent written English

* 2+ years of e-commerce CS support on Shopify and Gorgias

* Experience with return funnels

* Proficient in Google Sheets, 
 and Loom

* Bonus points: Experience with UK customers & pet/home-goods brands



### Accountabilities



* Handle
 tickets on Gorgias promptly, within our response-time target

* Process order changes/refunds in Shopify

* Coordinate with the fulfilment team on order issues

* Escalate and report unusual cases & patterns

* Send brief EOD reports: tickets closed, backlog, response time, refunds...



### How our hiring works



Our process: initial screening, a skill test, then a video interview. Shortlisted candidates are offered a paid trial week, then move to full-time if they meet the KPI targets.



### Salary



USD $900–1200 per month, based on experience, paid twice a month. Long-term role with the potential to grow into a CS Lead as the team grows.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Accounting Assistant



We’re hiring an Accounting Assistant to support tracking, documenting, and reconciling

renovation and restart expenses for a heavy manufacturing business. This role will help ensure

that vendor invoices, purchase orders, receipts, payment records, and project cost reports are

accurate, complete, and organized. The Accounting Assistant will work closely with the lead

accountant, plant team, vendors, and contractors to keep project spending visible and records

ready for review and approval.



Why You’ll Love This Role



 Contribute directly to the renovation and restart of an industrial facility.

 Work closely with the lead accountant and plant team, with clear visibility into project

spending.

 Help maintain reliable cost records so the team can make informed decisions and

manage the project budget.

 Build experience in project accounting, accounts payable, and construction or industrial

facility cost tracking.

Your Typical Day

 Collect, review, code, and file invoices, receipts, purchase orders, and other expense

documentation.

 Enter expenses into spreadsheets or the accounting system and maintain an up-to-date

expense tracker.

 Match invoices to purchase orders, quotes, delivery records, and approvals when

available.

 Follow up with vendors, contractors, and internal team members to resolve missing

documentation or discrepancies.

 Assist the lead accountant with reconciling vendor statements, tracking payments, and

preparing cost summaries.



What You’ll Be Doing



1) Invoice and Expense Processing



 Receive and organize invoices and expense submissions related to the Clewiston facility

renovation, repairs, equipment, supplies, freight, and installation.

 Check invoices for basic accuracy, including vendor details, invoice dates and numbers,

descriptions, quantities, rates, extensions, and supporting documents.

 Code expenses to the appropriate project, cost category, vendor, or budget line using

guidance from the lead accountant.

 Flag duplicate invoices, unexpected charges, mathematical errors, missing approvals,

and other potential issues for review.

 Maintain a clear record of invoice status, approval, due date, and payment status; do not

release or authorize payments independently.



2) Project Budget and Cost Tracking



 Update the renovation expense tracker and compare recorded costs with the approved

budget or estimates.

 Track commitments and actual costs for contractors, roof repairs, equipment purchases,

dismantling, freight, installation, utilities, and other facility work as assigned.

 Maintain supporting records for purchase orders, quotes, change orders, work

authorizations, delivery tickets, and receipts.

 Help identify cost overruns, unbudgeted items, duplicate charges, and variances for the

lead accountant to investigate.

 Assist with monthly cost summaries and forecasts by compiling current spending,

outstanding invoices, and anticipated expenses



3) Vendor Coordination and Recordkeeping



 Contact vendors and contractors to obtain missing invoices, receipts, W-9s, statements,

lien waivers, or other required documentation, as applicable.

 Maintain organized digital files so each expense can be traced to its supporting

documentation and approval.

 Reconcile vendor statements to recorded invoices and payments, escalating

discrepancies to the lead accountant.

 Coordinate with the plant manager and project team to confirm that goods or services

were received before invoices are submitted for approval.

 Protect confidential financial and vendor information and follow established document-

retention and approval procedures.

What We’re Looking For

 2–4+ years in accounting support, accounts payable, bookkeeping, project

administration, or a related role.

 Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize a high volume of invoices and

supporting documents.

 Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data entry, sorting, filters, and basic

formulas.

 Comfort communicating professionally with vendors, contractors, and internal team

members to resolve routine questions.

 Dependability, discretion, follow-through, and the ability to meet deadlines.

 Ability to work from invoices, quotes, receipts, purchase orders, and other source

documents without losing track of details.



Nice to Have



 Experience supporting construction, industrial, manufacturing, equipment, or facility

renovation projects.

 Familiarity with accounting software, accounts-payable workflows, purchase orders, and

vendor reconciliations.

 Experience maintaining project budgets, cost codes, or job-costing spreadsheets.

 Coursework, certificate, or degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.



To apply:



Send your resume

A vocaroo recording and answer this question: 

What's your experience in Heavy Industrial Manufacturing / Industrial Facility Operations? 

How many years in Accounting space?

Hiring: YouTube Video Editor (Long-Form + Short-Form)



We're looking for a talented, creative, and reliable video editor to join our growing travel and lifestyle YouTube channel.



**Responsibilities:**

- Edit engaging long-form YouTube videos (typically 20–40 minutes).

- Create attention-grabbing short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram and
.

- Develop compelling storytelling, pacing, and transitions to maintain viewer retention.

- Incorporate music, sound effects, motion graphics, subtitles, and B-roll where appropriate.

- Identify viral-worthy moments within long-form videos and turn them into standalone clips.

- Handle basic colour grading, audio enhancement, and visual effects.

- Collaborate on creative ideas to continually improve video performance.



**Requirements:**

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, hooks, pacing, and audience retention.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro.

- Experience producing engaging vertical short-form content.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

- Experience with travel vlogs or documentary-style content is highly desirable.



**What we're looking for:**



Someone who understands that great YouTube editing isn't just about flashy transitions. It's about making viewers want to keep watching.



**To apply, please provide:**

1. Your portfolio, including at least two long-form YouTube edits.

2. Examples of short-form videos you've produced.

3. Your expected monthly salary or per-video rate.

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 20-40 minute video.

5. Your editing software and availability.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.

title: URGENT Female Customer Service & Sales Representative – Curtains & Window Treatments Account
description:
We are looking for a customer-focused and sales-oriented Customer Service Representative to join our e-commerce team. The ideal candidate should have experience in customer service or online sales, preferably in curtains, window treatments, home décor, or related products.



The candidate must be comfortable assisting customers with curtain selection, explaining product specifications, guiding customers on proper window measurements, and recommending suitable products based on their needs.



Qualifications



At least a Senior High School graduate.

Experience in customer service, sales, or e-commerce is preferred.

Experience selling curtains, window treatments, or home décor products is a strong advantage.

Knowledge of curtain types, fabrics, styles, sizes, and installation options is an advantage.

Ability to guide customers on how to measure windows accurately for curtains, including width and length.

Ability to recommend suitable curtain sizes and styles based on customer measurements and preferences.

Comfortable assisting customers with product inquiries, pricing, customization options, orders, and delivery concerns.

Experience handling customer inquiries through phone calls, live chat,
, or social media.

Strong sales and communication skills, with the ability to recommend products and convert inquiries into sales.

Patient, detail-oriented, and attentive when handling customer measurements and customized orders.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle customer complaints professionally.

Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.

Must have a complete work-from-home setup.

Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 20 Mbps.



Key Responsibilities



Respond to customer inquiries regarding curtains, window treatments, product specifications, pricing, and customization.

Assist customers in selecting the right curtain styles, fabrics, sizes, and designs based on their needs.

Guide customers through the proper process of measuring their windows for accurate curtain sizing.

Verify customer-provided measurements and clarify details before processing customized orders.

Recommend suitable products and upsell relevant options when appropriate.

Assist customers with order placement, order status, shipping, returns, and other post-purchase concerns.

Maintain accurate customer records and ensure that order details and measurements are properly documented.

Provide excellent customer service while helping achieve sales and customer satisfaction targets.



Preferred Candidate



We are looking for someone who is sales-driven, customer-focused, detail-oriented, and confident in explaining curtain products and measurements. Candidates with previous experience in curtain sales, home furnishings, interior décor, or e-commerce sales will have an advantage.

title: Phone Sales – Insurance Appointment Setter/ Outbound Calls $560-790
description:
**Salary:** $3–$4 USD/hour (Based on Experience & Performance)

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Schedule:** US Business Hours

**English:** Excellent Spoken English Required

**Spanish:** A Plus, Not Required



### Job Description



We are a US-based life insurance agency looking for reliable, motivated Virtual Assistants to help connect potential customers with our licensed insurance agents.



We use **ReadyMode, an automated dialing system**, that automatically connects you with live prospects. You will not need to manually dial numbers or find your own leads.



Your job is simple: speak with prospects, follow our script, ask basic qualifying questions, and transfer interested prospects to our licensed agents or schedule appointments.



We provide the leads, dialer, scripts, and training.



### Responsibilities



- Handle live calls automatically connected through ReadyMode.

- Follow provided scripts and ask basic qualifying questions.

- Identify interested prospects and transfer them to licensed agents.

- Schedule appointments or callbacks when necessary.

- Handle basic objections professionally.

- Update call dispositions and customer notes.

- Communicate clearly and respectfully with US customers, primarily seniors.



### Requirements



- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation.

- Previous call center, appointment-setting, or telemarketing experience preferred.

- Confident speaking with customers over the phone.

- Ability to follow scripts and handle rejection.

- Reliable computer, stable internet, and quality headset.

- Available to work during US business hours.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus, but not required.



### Compensation & Benefits



- **Starting Pay: $3–$4 USD/hour**, depending on experience.

- **Up to $5 USD/hour** for proven, high-performing candidates.

- Opportunity for performance-based bonuses.

- Paid training.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing US insurance agency.

- All leads, software, and scripts provided.



### How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

2. Your previous experience in call centers, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

4. Your availability to work US business hours.

5. Your internet speed and equipment setup.



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the word **READYMODE** so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for dependable, coachable individuals who communicate confidently and want a long-term opportunity with our team.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager – Outreach & Creator Partnerships (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Know how to start a conversation with a creator and turn it into a paid campaign? Join Cybertribe and take ownership of creator outreach, sponsorship negotiations, and campaign delivery.




 is a global influencer marketing agency with 8+ years of experience across gaming, iGaming, crypto, tech, and sports. We work with brands and creators worldwide.



You’ll work with creator databases, our CRM, and clear internal guides. We’re looking for someone who follows through, writes well, and keeps conversations and campaigns organised.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

- Find suitable creators in our databases and contact them across social platforms.

- Follow up, discuss sponsorship opportunities, and negotiate rates and deliverables.

- Collect the information needed to move deals forward and keep records up to date.

- Coordinate campaigns for your own group of creators, tracking deadlines and delivery.

- Send clear updates to clients and help resolve delays or missing information.



YOU’LL BE A GOOD FIT IF

- You have hands-on influencer marketing experience.

- You can write natural, professional English for outreach, negotiations, and client updates.

- You stay on top of follow-ups and deadlines across multiple conversations.

- You can follow SOPs and checklists independently.

- You take responsibility when something needs attention and help move it forward.

- Experience with sales outreach, Google Sheets, or Excel is a plus.



PAY AND WORKING HOURS

- $300 USD per month, fixed for the first three months of the trial period.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, fully remote.

- Some overlap with European working hours is preferred. Our clients operate across different time zones.

- Payment by bank transfer or crypto.

- Ownership of your campaigns and room to grow within the team.



TO APPLY

Keep your application short and write it in English.

- Introduce yourself and describe one influencer campaign you worked on. Tell us which platform it involved and what you personally handled.

- Give one example of a paid sponsorship format for each platform — YouTube, Instagram, and Twitch. One line per platform is enough.

- Share your availability in Philippine time and confirm that the starting salary of $300 USD per month works for you for the first three months of the trial period.

title: Social Media Growth Director, Fitness & Performance
description:
Social Media Growth Director, Fitness & Performance



We are a fast-growing mindset, fitness, health, and performance coaching company for ambitious men.



We are looking for a proven Social Media Growth Director to take ownership of our entire social media operation.



This is not an entry-level social media manager role.



You must have several years of real experience and a proven record of success specifically in the:



- Fitness industry

- Health and wellness industry

- Performance coaching industry

- Personal development or life coaching industry



Fitness experience is required. Life-coaching experience is a plus, but fitness and performance marketing come first.



You must be able to show real proof of your previous work, including:



- Social media accounts you helped grow

- Fitness or health brands you worked with

- Audience growth results

- Lead-generation results

- Qualified conversations or booked-call results

- Content examples

- Case studies

- References or verifiable employers



The Opportunity



We already have:



- Stefan’s personal brand and authority

- A large library of fitness, mindset, and performance content

- An AI editor capable of producing thousands of high-quality content assets

- Multiple Instagram, TikTok,
, and other social-media accounts

- A chatbot system being deployed across additional accounts

- A high-ticket coaching offer

- A sales team and fulfillment infrastructure



Your job is to turn this content and technology into a serious social-media growth and acquisition machine.



You will be expected to operate as if this were your own company.



This requires judgment, urgency, ownership, and measurable results. We are not looking for someone who simply schedules posts.



Responsibilities



You will own:



- Social-media strategy

- Content distribution across multiple accounts

- Publishing calendars

- Platform growth

- Content quality control

- Feedback to the AI editor

- Identifying winning hooks, formats, and topics

- Comments and community engagement

- Social-media inbox coordination

- Chatbot and setter handoff

- Organic lead generation

- Qualified conversation growth

- Booked-call contribution

- Weekly reporting and performance analysis

- Account health and platform compliance

- Continuous improvement of the social-media system



You must be able to look at content and explain clearly:



- Why it will or will not perform

- What should be improved

- Which audience it targets

- What CTA it should use

- Where it should be distributed

- How it can contribute to qualified leads and booked calls



Compensation



Paid probationary performance period:



- Month 1: €700

- Month 2: €800

- Month 3: €900



After successful probation:



- €1,200/month base salary



After Month 6, there is potential to increase the base salary to €1,500–€2,000/month based on proven performance.



Additional upside may include:



- Quarterly performance bonuses

- Incentives tied to qualified booked calls and organic revenue

- Long-term phantom-equity eligibility after proven performance and continued commitment

- The possibility to earn €3,000–€4,000+ per month over time through base pay, bonuses, and incentives if the company grows and your results justify it



Bonuses are based on measurable performance, not vanity metrics such as followers or likes.



Performance Scorecard



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Publishing reliability

- Content quality

- Platform health

- Audience quality

- Qualified conversations

- Booked calls

- Organic revenue contribution

- AI-editor feedback quality

- Chatbot and setter coordination

- Ability to build repeatable systems



Who This Is For



You are:



- Highly experienced

- Obsessed with social media

- Extremely organized

- Fast and proactive

- Comfortable owning outcomes

- Strong at written communication

- Experienced in fitness marketing

- Able to work independently

- Interested in building one company long term

- Motivated by significant upside tied to company growth



You are not someone who waits for instructions for every task.



You see problems, solve them, and report what happened.



Application Requirements



Please send:



1. Your CV or work history  

2. Three relevant fitness, health, or performance case studies  

3. The exact accounts or companies you worked with  

4. Your specific responsibilities  

5. Starting audience and ending audience  

6. Lead, booked-call, or revenue results where available  

7. Links to content you personally managed  

8. At least two professional references  

9. Your expected compensation after probation  

10. A short explanation of why you want to build one company long term  

11. A short audit of our social media and the first three things you would improve  



Applications without verifiable fitness-industry experience will not be considered.



This role is designed for someone who wants to build, own, and grow the social-media division of a serious fitness and performance company.

title: Retention Specialist (Remote)
description:

We received several applications for this role. Only applicants who follow the instructions in this post will be contacted.



About the role

We’re hiring Retention Specialists to support fast-growing direct-to-consumer brands. You will talk to customers who want to cancel, pause or get a refund, and keep as many of them as you can while still treating them fairly. You’ll also bring back customers who have already left.

Handle inbound calls, chats and
s from customers who want to cancel or return an order

Find out why they want to leave and offer the right fix, such as a different product, a changed shipping schedule, a pause or a discount

Win back lapsed subscribers through outreach

Talk with customers about their needs with care and patience

Process cancels, refunds and subscription changes accurately in the billing system

Log the reasons customers leave and share patterns with the team

Hit monthly save-rate and retention targets



What we’re looking for



1+ year of proven sales experience (inbound or outbound phone sales, upselling, or closing) with a track record of hitting targets

2+ years of experience in retention, customer success or subscription support for an e-commerce brand

Confident asking for the save and handling objections without being pushy

Hands-on experience with subscription and checkout platforms such as 
, Checkout Champ, ShipMonk and Jetpack

Strong written and spoken English with a calm, friendly tone

Experience with a helpdesk or CRM tool, such as Gorgias, Zendesk or similar

Good with numbers. You can track your own save rate and explain it

Reliable, quiet workspace for remote work



Work-from-home tech requirements



Desktop or laptop computer with at least 12GB of RAM (no tablets or phones for work)

Stable, wired or strong Wi-Fi internet connection

Noise-canceling headset with a working microphone

Working webcam. Your camera must stay on during training

Dual monitor setup

Quiet, private workspace with no background noise

Backup internet or power option is a plus



Please complete the WFH tech requirements form here: 



Nice to have



Experience with supplements, health or wellness products

Experience with chargebacks and refund policies

title: Canadian Sales Manager - Zip Hinges
description:
Canadian Sales Manager – Zip Hinges



Full-time remote opportunity | Canadian territory | Canadian business hours



Job Description



Advance Building Supplies is hiring an experienced sales professional to lead the growth of Zip Hinge and other assigned exterior products across Canada. This is a hands-on selling role with responsibility for developing new accounts, closing orders and building repeat business—not simply responding to incoming inquiries.



You will sell through distributors, contractors, homeowners, retail suppliers, online channels and Amazon. Your product portfolio will expand as additional exterior products join the business. Working directly with the owner, marketing and the wider sales team, you will combine incoming leads with proactive outreach and consistent follow-up.



We will train you on our products. You should already have a developed sales approach and the ability to put it to work.





Company Description



Advance Building Supplies supplies specialty exterior products to customers across Canada. Zip Hinge is a downspout-hinge product sold to contractors, dealers, suppliers and homeowners. Rapid growth in this newer Canadian product line has created the need for a dedicated person to develop its national sales.



Our marketing person manages campaigns and digital lead generation, while product sales representatives handle customer relationships and closing. Gutter-machine inquiries go to our dedicated machine sales representative. We want to build a lucrative, meaningful long-term career with someone whose contribution is visible.

Product information: 





Compensation



Compensation will be performance-based. Our ambition is to offer meaningful responsibility, room to grow and earning potential well above typical pay for comparable roles—a potentially life-changing opportunity for the right high performer.



A minimum draw will be provided to help maintain consistent pay during slower periods. Expected monthly earnings, commission rates, the draw amount and how the draw is reconciled will be explained during hiring and agreed in writing before you accept.



Expected salary for sales commissions if hitting all required metrics would be 100,000 PHP+ per month.  We expect this to be a truly life changing career, but it comes with hard work.





Job Expectations and Performance Metrics



The manager will be expected to meet and work to exceed agreed weekly communication, sales, follow-up and quotation targets. Responsibilities and measures include:



1. Prospecting: Make outbound calls, reach decision-makers and develop new accounts; track calls and meaningful 

customer conversations.



2. Sales and follow-up: Respond to inquiries, explain approved pricing, handle objections, prepare quotes and close orders; track follow-ups due and completed, quotes, orders and sales value.



3. Account development: Maintain customer relationships and identify repeat-order opportunities; track new customers, repeat business and overall Canadian product sales growth.



4. Accountability: Keep CRM records and next steps current, attend the daily team meeting and provide a concise weekly scorecard. Raise missed commitments and obstacles promptly.



Specific numerical targets will be agreed as part of the role’s performance expectations.





Who Is the Right Candidate?



You are an ambitious, disciplined seller who enjoys opening doors and earning repeat business. You can work independently, handle rejection constructively and keep following up without being chased. You welcome clear targets, communicate honestly and want to build a long-term career around results.





Prerequisites / Requirements



1. Demonstrated phone-sales experience, including outbound prospecting, objection handling and closing.



2. Strong spoken and written English, accurate CRM use and confidence speaking with business owners.



3. Reliable internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a professional calling environment.



4. Availability for a minimum of 40 hours per week during Canadian business hours. Working hours may vary to reach customers across Canadian time zones.



Experience with contractors, distributors or building products is an asset. Product training is provided; established selling ability is required.





Application Process / Requirements



Apply through this listing with all of the following:



1. Resume and availability: Include your current work situation and earliest start date.



2. Working-hours confirmation: Confirm that you can meet the 40-hour weekly commitment and work during Canadian 

business hours.



3. An account you won: Describe a business customer you personally acquired through outbound outreach. What did you sell, how many contacts did it take and what secured the order? State the result and currency, any repeat business, and how 

you tracked follow-up. Anonymize confidential details.



4. A follow-up scenario: An exterior contractor says, “We already have a supplier. Just
 me something.” Write your response, the next step you would seek and your follow-up plan for the next seven days. Include what you would record in the CRM. Do not invent discounts or product claims.



5. Introduction video: Provide a video of yourself, at least 30 seconds long, introducing your relevant experience and interest in the role.



6. AI disclosure: Add one line explaining whether and how you used AI in your application.



AI-assisted editing is welcome. AI-written answers are not. Start with your own answers, examples and reasoning. You may 

use AI to improve grammar, clarity or organization, but not to generate the substance of your responses or invent experience and results.



We will run written responses through an AI-content checker as part of our review. A checker result is not proof of authorship and will not, by itself, disqualify you. We will also review your evidence and may ask you to explain your answers live. We want your thinking, not a polished answer you cannot stand behind.



Applications missing any of the required items will not be reviewed.

title: YouTube Video Editor + Motion Graphics (work with a 1M+ sub creator & channel)
description:
WHO WE ARE



Compound One Studios makes long-form YouTube videos for different finance and investing channels. We are the team behind New Money, one of the biggest investing channels on YouTube with over 1 million subscribers. Our work is taking a complicated money topic and making it clear and easy to watch.



THE JOB



We're hiring one full-time YouTube editor who can make good motion graphics to own videos from first cut to final export. That's around 6+ long-form videos a month, usually 10 to 25 minutes each.



You'll:



- Shape raw footage into a video people want to keep watching: the hook, the pacing, the story.

- Work out what should be on screen so a complicated money idea becomes easy to understand.

- Build charts, numbers and explainer animations, using motion graphics you build, as well as some of our templates. We don't mind if you use AI tools too, as long as the quality is high, we don't mind how we get the best results.

- Check that every number on screen is right, and speak up when something doesn't add up.

- Finish sound, colour and export to our checklists.



WHAT YOU NEED



- At least 2 years editing long-form YouTube videos (8+ minutes) for clients.

- Premiere Pro and After Effects or similar.

- Examples of graphics you made that explain something, not just templated animations that decorate the screen.

- Good YouTube retention instincts. You know why someone keeps watching and why they leave.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Great attention to detail.

- A computer with 16 GB+ of RAM and a dedicated graphics card, plus reliable internet.

- An ability to tell us early, and communicate well if you are likely to miss a deadline or something is going to slip.



You don't need a finance background but a basic understanding of investing concepts is a big bonus. We can teach you. Curiosity and care with numbers matter more.



THE HARD PARTS



- We give a lot of detailed feedback, and every video goes through a checklist.

- Our videos are graphics heavy and the standard is high.

- This is an exclusive, full-time role of 40 hours a week. Sydney is 3 hours ahead of Manila, and we need a few hours of overlap each day with Sydney business hours.



WHAT YOU GET



- PHP 54,000 to 96,000 a month as an independent contractor. Where you start depends on the quality of your work.

- One team and steady monthly pay, instead of chasing clients.

- Regular feedback from the people behind New Money.

- Room to move up and grow (in role and in salary) as you prove yourself.

- A world-class education in how to make high-quality YouTube content working directly with one of the top creators in finance and investing.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this form only. It takes about 5 minutes, and you don't need a CV or cover letter: 



Messages sent without the form won't be read. Individuals only, no agencies.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. A short unpaid edit, a few hours.

2. A paid sample, about one working day.

3. A Google Meet call or interview.

4. A real paid project on a real client video working alongside our actual team.

5. An offer.



We review applications multiple times per week.

Our target clients include general contractors, roofers, plumbers, pool service companies, restaurants, and other U.S. businesses.



Our first project will be developing our own agency website, which will serve as a showcase for potential clients. Successful completion could lead to consistent projects and long-term collaboration as our agency grows.



## What We're Looking For



We want websites that feel like an interactive cinematic experience, not simply traditional websites with video backgrounds.



Examples of the features we're interested in include:



- Scroll-triggered animations and cinematic page transitions.

- Interactive product configurators and customizable experiences.

- Elements that respond to scrolling, mouse movements, clicks, and user selections.

- Parallax effects, layered animations, and immersive 3D-style visuals.

- AI-generated cinematic imagery and videos integrated into functional websites.

- Smooth animations optimized for desktop and mobile.

- Modern, visually impressive layouts designed to convert visitors into customers.



**Experience with GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Three.js, WebGL, Framer Motion, or similar technologies is highly desirable.**



## Responsibilities



- Design and develop premium cinematic and interactive websites.

- Create engaging animations, transitions, and interactive user experiences.

- Utilize AI-powered design and development tools to improve creativity and efficiency.

- Build fast, responsive, mobile-friendly websites.

- Integrate lead capture forms, booking systems, and CRM platforms.

- Collaborate with our team to integrate AI chatbots, AI voice agents, and GoHighLevel automations.

- Handle website deployment, updates, and technical maintenance.

- Develop reusable components and templates for future client projects.



## Required Qualifications



- Strong portfolio of live websites you personally designed or developed.

- Experience with Framer, Webflow, WordPress, custom development, or comparable platforms.

- Strong UI/UX design skills and understanding of modern website development.

- Demonstrated experience with advanced animations and interactive functionality.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted design and development tools.

- Strong communication skills, creativity, and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.



## Preferred Skills



- GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Three.js, WebGL, or advanced JavaScript animation.

- AI-generated cinematic videos and visual effects, including tools such as Higgsfield.

- Interactive product configurators and 3D experiences.

- GoHighLevel website, CRM, and automation integrations.

- AI chatbot and voice agent integrations.

title: Senior Amazon Brand & Growth Manager | Established 7-Figure Private Label Business
description:
Full-Time, 40 Hours/Week  

Salary $1,500–$2,000 USD/Month (Based on Experience)  

Position: Long-Term



About the Opportunity



We are an established, profitable, 7-figure Amazon private label business selling in the US marketplace, with a diversified portfolio of physical products.



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Brand & Growth Manager to take ownership of our commercial growth initiatives, improve the performance of our existing products, and help us scale the business further.



We already have dedicated team members managing PPC advertising and supply chain operations independently.



Our next step is to bring in someone who can lead brand growth, identify new opportunities, develop strategies, and ensure their successful execution.



This is not a traditional Amazon Virtual Assistant position.



We are looking for a strategic thinker and proactive problem-solver who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver measurable business results without constant supervision.



 Key Responsibilities



 Amazon Listing Optimization & Conversion

- Audit existing product listings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Develop compelling, conversion-focused titles, bullet points, and A+ Content strategies.

- Conduct keyword research and implement Amazon SEO best practices.

- Analyze competitors' listings, images, pricing, reviews, and positioning.

- Develop creative briefs and coordinate with designers to improve product imagery.

- Plan and evaluate A/B tests to improve conversion rates.



 Brand Growth & Strategy

- Develop and execute strategies to increase sales, market share, and profitability.

- Identify opportunities to improve existing products' competitive positioning.

- Analyze sales trends, customer behavior, and competitor activity.

- Recommend pricing strategies, product variations, bundles, and other growth opportunities.

- Identify underperforming products and develop actionable improvement plans.

- Prioritize projects based on potential business impact.



 New Product Launches

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis for new product opportunities.

- Evaluate market demand, pricing, competition, and profitability potential.

- Develop and coordinate go-to-market strategies.

- Work with the existing team to prepare and execute product launches.

- Monitor launch performance and implement improvements.



 Team Collaboration & Project Management

- Collaborate with our PPC Specialist and Supply Chain Manager.

- Coordinate designers, freelancers, and other external resources when necessary.

- Manage project timelines, priorities, and deliverables.

- Ensure projects move forward independently without constant direction from the business owner.

- Provide regular progress updates and actionable recommendations.



 Performance Analysis

- Monitor key metrics, including revenue, profit margins, TACOS, ACoS, conversion rates, organic sales, and average order value.

- Identify performance trends and areas for improvement.

- Develop data-driven growth strategies.

- Prepare concise weekly performance and project updates.



 Requirements



Must Have:

- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with Amazon private label brands.

- Proven experience managing or growing established Amazon businesses.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and product launches.

- Strong analytical skills and understanding of e-commerce profitability.

- Experience with competitor research and market positioning.

- Excellent English communication and copywriting skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate with team members.

- Highly proactive, independent, and results-oriented.



Nice to Have:

- Experience managing 7-figure Amazon brands.

- Experience using Helium 10, Amazon Brand Analytics, and Manage Your Experiments.

- Proven success improving conversion rates, organic rankings, or profitability.

- Experience coordinating creative teams and managing new product launches.

- Previous experience in a Brand Manager, Growth Manager, or E-commerce Manager role.



 Who We're Looking For



We want someone who thinks beyond assigned tasks.



Someone who notices when a product is losing market share, investigates why, develops a recovery strategy, and takes initiative to implement improvements.



Someone who understands that profitable growth matters more than revenue alone.



Most importantly, someone who can independently identify opportunities, make informed decisions, and take responsibility for delivering results.



We value demonstrated experience, problem-solving skills, initiative, and accountability over certifications or job titles.



What We Offer



- Competitive salary of $1,500–$2,000/month, depending on experience.

- Stable, long-term, full-time remote employment.

- Opportunity to play an important role in growing an established and profitable business.

- Significant autonomy and ownership of growth initiatives.

- An existing team supporting advertising and supply chain operations.

- Direct communication with the business owner.

- Potential for performance-based bonuses and career growth.



 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your Experience



Describe the Amazon private label brands you've worked with, their approximate annual revenue, and your specific responsibilities.



2. Your Achievements



Provide 2–3 concrete examples of how you contributed to improving sales, profitability, conversion rates, organic rankings, or product launches.



Please include measurable results wherever possible.



3. Strategic Thinking



Imagine an established Amazon brand has experienced declining sales and profitability in one of its best-selling products due to increased competition.



What would be your first three steps to analyze the situation and develop a recovery strategy?



4. Additional Information



- Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

- Your expected monthly salary.

- Your availability to start.



Important: Start your application with the words "Growth Mindset" to confirm that you've carefully read this job posting.



Generic applications will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership, think strategically, and help us build the next stage of growth.

• 5+ years of professional video editing experience

• Ability to work independently without constant direction



Tools & Skills



Required:

• Organized timelines and file management



Bonus:

• After Effects

• Motion graphics

What This Role Is (and Isn’t)



This role is:

• Long-term

• Story driven

• Ownership based



This role is not:

• High-volume agency work

Compensation
