title: HVAC Service Administration & Invoicing Specialist
description:
You will work closely with our Australian administration team and field service technicians to assist with the day-to-day processing, invoicing and finalisation of completed HVAC service and repair jobs.



Your primary responsibility will be to ensure completed service jobs are accurately reviewed, processed, invoiced and closed out in our job management system.



We are looking for someone who understands how HVAC service businesses operate, can interpret technician job notes and has the technical awareness to recognise when information is missing, incorrect or requires further clarification.



The ideal candidate will be confident working independently, following established procedures and communicating with our Australian team.



Key Responsibilities



1. Service & Repair Job Invoicing



Review completed HVAC service, maintenance and repair jobs.



Prepare and process invoices using our job management software.



Check technician labour, materials, parts and service charges against approved pricing structures.



Apply established service rates, fixed-price repairs and customer-specific pricing.



Ensure invoices accurately reflect the work completed.



Finalise and close straightforward service and repair jobs.



Identify incomplete jobs, discrepancies or additional works requiring attention.



Escalate complex repairs, technical queries and non-standard invoicing to the appropriate team member.



2. HVAC Technical Administration



Read, interpret and understand HVAC technician service reports and job notes.



Recognise common HVAC components, faults, repairs and maintenance activities.



Understand basic air-conditioning and refrigeration terminology.



Differentiate between servicing, fault diagnosis, repairs, maintenance and installation works.



Identify when technician notes indicate additional repair recommendations or follow-up works.



Review job photographs, equipment details and supporting documentation.



Communicate with technicians or administration staff when clarification is required.



3. Job Management & Administration



Maintain accurate job records within our service management platform.



Ensure completed jobs have the appropriate notes, photographs, materials and supporting documentation.



Update job statuses and close completed work orders.



Assist with maintenance reporting and administrative follow-ups.



Identify jobs awaiting information or approval.



Maintain accurate records and ensure timely invoicing.



Support the administration team with general service-related tasks.



4. Future Responsibilities & Development



As you become familiar with our systems and processes, there will be opportunities to expand your responsibilities into:



Preparing straightforward HVAC repair quotations.



Assisting with maintenance contract administration.



Preparing preventative maintenance reports.



Warranty administration and documentation.



Supplier invoice and purchase order reconciliation.



Identifying additional works recommended by technicians.



Supporting the commercial HVAC service department.



Assisting with workflow improvements and administrative efficiencies.



Essential Experience & Requirements



Previous experience within an HVAC or Australian trades service business is strongly preferred.



Successful candidates should demonstrate:



Previous experience working for an HVAC, air-conditioning, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical or mechanical services contractor.



Experience with field service management software such as Ascora, Simpro, AroFlo or ServiceM8.



Proven experience preparing service and repair invoices from technician job notes.



A solid understanding of HVAC terminology, equipment, components and basic repair processes.



Ability to interpret technical job descriptions and service reports.



Familiarity with Australian trade service workflows and invoicing practices.



Strong written and spoken English.



Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.



Confidence using Microsoft Excel, Outlook and other business software.



Ability to work independently while maintaining clear communication with the team.



A reliable internet connection and professional remote working environment.



Highly Desirable



Direct experience using Ascora.



Previous employment with an Australian HVAC service contractor.



Experience with commercial HVAC preventative maintenance.



Familiarity with split systems, ducted systems, evaporative cooling, refrigeration and commercial air-conditioning.



Experience with fixed-price repair schedules and service callout pricing.



Experience preparing HVAC repair quotations.



Understanding of Australian GST and service invoicing practices.



Experience working with Australian property managers and commercial maintenance clients.



What We're Looking For



Technical knowledge is important, but attitude and reliability are equally valuable.



We want someone who:



Takes ownership of their work and follows tasks through to completion.



Is proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Is comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.



Has exceptional attention to detail.



Communicates clearly and consistently.



Takes pride in accurate, high-quality work.



Is organised and capable of managing multiple jobs.



Enjoys improving processes and finding better ways of working.



Wants to become a valued, long-term member of a growing Australian company.



What We Offer



Stable, full-time remote opportunity.



Long-term career development with an established Australian HVAC company.



Supportive and approachable Australian management team.



Structured onboarding and training.



Opportunity to expand into more advanced HVAC administration and quoting responsibilities.



A positive, team-focused workplace culture.



Competitive remuneration based on experience and technical knowledge.



At WestOz Trades, we believe in looking after our people, working together and creating an environment where everyone feels valued.

title: Inventory & Demand Planning Manager | AI-Native | Multi-Brand Ecommerce
description:
# Inventory & Demand Planning Manager | AI-Native | Multi-Brand Ecommerce



**TYPE OF WORK:** Full Time — Remote



**WAGE / SALARY:** $2,000–$3,000 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated results



**HOURS PER WEEK:** 40



**SKILL REQUIREMENTS:** Inventory Management | Forecasting | Supply Chain Management



## JOB OVERVIEW



### Our Best Sellers Should Never Be Out of Stock. Your Job Is to Make Sure of It.



Here's something we've learned from running multiple ecommerce businesses:



**When our best-selling products stay in stock, our businesses perform better. Significantly better.**



It sounds obvious.



And yet, across ecommerce, businesses lose enormous amounts of revenue because someone didn't forecast demand properly, didn't place an order early enough, didn't anticipate a marketing campaign, or didn't follow up with a supplier.



We're determined to eliminate that problem.



We're looking for an **exceptional Inventory & Demand Planning Manager** to take ownership of inventory planning, forecasting, replenishment, and supplier coordination across our growing portfolio of ecommerce brands.



This is one of the most financially important operational roles in our company.



We don't need someone who simply monitors stock levels and tells us when something is running low.



**We need someone who makes sure our best sellers never run low in the first place.**



Someone who sees problems months before they happen.



Someone who can recognize tomorrow's best sellers before everyone else does.



Someone who can use data, AI, commercial judgment, and proactive supplier coordination to ensure the right inventory is always available at the right time.



Most importantly, someone who takes complete ownership of the outcome.



### WHO WE ARE



oCommerce is a growing portfolio of consumer ecommerce companies operating across multiple industries.



Our brands include:



- **Agent84** — Fashion-forward athleisure and women's lifestyle apparel.

- **Skivys** — Women's comfort clothing and loungewear.

- **Blossomdale** — Plants, gardening, and lifestyle products.

- **Shrimpy Business** — A leading online retailer of freshwater aquarium shrimp, fish, plants, and supplies.



We also operate and develop additional brands across other consumer categories.



Our businesses sell thousands of product variations, across different categories, suppliers, manufacturing timelines, and customer purchasing patterns.



Some products have fashion-driven demand.



Others are purchased repeatedly throughout the year.



Some are seasonal. Others become unexpectedly popular because of advertising or social media.



Each business presents a different inventory planning challenge.



**Your mission is to build an inventory operation that stays ahead of all of them.**



## WHAT YOU'LL OWN



### 1. Know Every Product — Especially the Winners



Across every brand, you'll continuously analyze our products and classify them into three groups:



**Category A: All-Time Best Sellers**



These are proven products that consistently generate meaningful sales.



Your highest priority is protecting their availability.



You should know their sales velocity, historical demand, supplier lead times, inventory coverage, and exactly when the next order must be placed.



A preventable stockout of a major best seller should never be a surprise.



**Category B: Rising Best Sellers**



These are products whose sales are accelerating and which show the potential to become our next major revenue drivers.



Your job is to identify them early.



Then gradually increase their representation in replenishment orders as demand becomes more established.



This is important: we don't want to wait until a rising product becomes a proven all-time bestseller before increasing our purchasing commitment.



**Category C: Slow-Moving and Underperforming Products**



These are products that consume cash and warehouse space without generating sufficient sales.



You'll identify them, monitor their performance, reduce unnecessary replenishment, and recommend ways to improve inventory efficiency.



**These categories are not permanent.**



A rising bestseller can become a core bestseller.



A former bestseller can decline.



A slow mover can suddenly accelerate.



You'll maintain an accurate, continuously updated classification of our entire product portfolio.



Not once every six months.



Continuously.



### 2. Own Inventory Forecasting and Replenishment



We have already invested in developing automated inventory forecasting and replenishment workflows.



You'll inherit these systems, take ownership of them, validate their accuracy, and make them better.



You'll use historical sales, actual selling velocity, current stock, inbound purchase orders, supplier lead times, safety stock, and anticipated demand to determine:



- What needs to be reordered.

- How much needs to be ordered.

- When orders need to be placed.

- When inventory is expected to arrive.

- Which products are at risk of stocking out.

- Where we may be overstocked.

- How purchasing should be prioritized within available budgets.



You'll forecast at the appropriate SKU and variant level, including style, color, size, and length where relevant.



You must understand the difference between a product selling slowly and a product appearing to sell slowly because it was unavailable for half the month.



**A stockout should not trick your forecasting model into believing demand has disappeared.**



You'll account for seasonality, new launches, changing business performance, promotional periods, and actual sales opportunities.



We expect you to understand forecasting deeply enough to challenge a model when its recommendations don't make commercial sense.



### 3. Work Directly With Our Advertising and Retention Marketing Teams



This is one of the most important parts of the job.



Historical sales data only tells you part of the story.



**You need to understand what our marketing teams are planning to sell tomorrow.**



You'll work proactively with our:



- Paid Advertising Team

- Retention Marketing Team 
 and SMS)

- Brand Managers

- Product and Operations Teams



You'll understand upcoming product launches, promotional calendars, advertising budget increases, featured products,
 campaigns, and expected demand spikes.



Imagine our advertising team plans to aggressively scale spending on a particular product next month.



You notice that our existing stock will only cover three weeks of normal demand.



A typical inventory coordinator might notice the problem once inventory starts running low.



**An exceptional inventory manager identifies the conflict immediately, calculates the risk, speaks with the advertising team, and coordinates with suppliers to find a solution before the campaign launches.**



That's the standard we're looking for.



We don't want inventory planning operating independently from marketing.



We want marketing and inventory working together to maximize revenue.



### 4. Own Supplier and Factory Coordination



Forecasting means nothing if the products don't arrive.



You will communicate directly with our factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and other relevant partners.



Your responsibilities include:



- Preparing and coordinating replenishment purchase orders.

- Understanding production timelines, minimum order quantities, and supplier capacity.

- Confirming manufacturing and delivery schedules.

- Following up proactively on production progress.

- Coordinating with logistics and warehouse teams.

- Tracking incoming shipments and expected arrival dates.

- Identifying delays early and implementing recovery plans.

- Maintaining accurate purchase order and inbound inventory records.

- Negotiating improved lead times, terms, and purchasing arrangements where possible.



You must understand the full journey of a product, from purchase order to available inventory.



**An order being placed does not mean your job is finished.**



Your responsibility continues until the inventory is actually available for customers to purchase.



If a factory misses a deadline, we should hear about the proposed solution from you—not discover the problem when the product goes out of stock.



### 5. Become an AI-Native Inventory Manager



AI is central to how we want this department to operate.



We're not looking for someone who occasionally asks ChatGPT to help with a spreadsheet formula.



We're looking for someone who understands how AI can fundamentally improve demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, supplier coordination, and operational decision-making.



You'll be expected to use AI and automation to:



- Analyze large volumes of SKU-level sales data.

- Identify emerging best sellers and declining products.

- Maintain and improve automated demand forecasts.

- Detect unusual changes in sales velocity.

- Flag potential stockouts before they become urgent.

- Incorporate marketing plans into inventory projections.

- Generate replenishment recommendations.

- Monitor supplier delays and outstanding purchase orders.

- Build dashboards and exception-based alerts.

- Automate repetitive reporting and follow-up processes.



We're especially interested in people who have experience with ChatGPT, Claude, AI automation platforms, scripting, or advanced spreadsheet workflows.



**We want you to build a system that watches our inventory continuously—not one that depends on someone remembering to open a spreadsheet.**



But we're equally clear about something else:



AI doesn't replace judgment.



You are accountable for validating the data, understanding the assumptions, checking the recommendations, and making sound decisions.



An AI-generated forecast is not a substitute for knowing your business.



### 6. Protect Revenue Without Wasting Cash



Keeping products in stock is only half the equation.



The other half is avoiding unnecessary inventory.



Every dollar tied up in slow-moving stock is a dollar we cannot invest elsewhere.



You'll need to understand the relationship between inventory availability, purchasing budgets, sales velocity, product margins, and working capital.



Your goal is to:



**Maximize availability of products customers want while minimizing capital tied up in products they don't.**



That means making intelligent trade-offs.



It means knowing when to order aggressively and when to be conservative.



It means understanding how product demand changes over time.



And it means having the confidence to recommend against unnecessary purchases, even when a supplier is offering attractive terms.



We expect strong financial judgment—not simply maintaining large amounts of stock.



### 7. Take Complete Ownership — Without Constant Leadership Supervision



This may be our most important requirement.



We operate multiple businesses.



Our leadership team cannot spend its time chasing suppliers, checking spreadsheets, answering routine inventory questions, or reminding people to place purchase orders.



**That's why we're hiring you.**



We're looking for a person who takes a problem and owns it until it is solved.



If you identify a potential stockout, we don't want a message saying:



"We might run out of this product. What should I do?"



We want something like:



"This bestseller has approximately 35 days of inventory remaining. Our supplier's normal lead time is 60 days, and the advertising team plans to increase promotion next month. I've confirmed an expedited production option, calculated the incremental cost, and recommend proceeding with an additional order. Here are the numbers and the decision I need approved."



That's ownership.



You should independently investigate problems, communicate with the necessary teams, evaluate alternatives, and bring leadership clear recommendations when approvals are necessary.



**Our leadership team should spend less time managing inventory because you're here—not more.**



## HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOUR SUCCESS



We care about outcomes, not how many spreadsheets you maintain.



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



**1. Best Seller Availability**



Are our most important products consistently in stock? Are preventable stockouts declining?



**2. Rising Best Seller Identification**



Are we identifying new winning products early enough and increasing replenishment appropriately?



**3. Forecast Accuracy**



Are your forecasts improving over time? Are purchasing recommendations supported by reliable data?



**4. Inventory Efficiency**



Are we maintaining appropriate stock coverage without excessive overstock or unnecessary capital commitments?



**5. Supplier Reliability**



Are purchase orders placed on time, production schedules monitored, and delays resolved proactively?



**6. Marketing Alignment**



Are upcoming campaigns and advertising plans accurately reflected in purchasing decisions?



**7. Ownership and Independence**



Are problems being solved without repeated leadership intervention? Are decisions presented clearly, with evidence and recommendations?



Ultimately, **we want to see more sales protected, fewer preventable stockouts, smarter purchasing, and less management overhead.**



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



**At least 3–5 years of meaningful inventory planning, demand forecasting, or purchasing experience**, preferably in direct-to-consumer ecommerce.



We strongly prefer candidates who have personally owned replenishment decisions rather than simply maintaining inventory records.



You should demonstrate:



- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, forecasting models, and scenario analysis.

- Hands-on experience with Shopify or comparable ecommerce inventory systems.

- Strong understanding of sales velocity, reorder points, safety stock, inventory coverage, and supplier lead times.

- Proven experience communicating with manufacturers or suppliers and managing purchase orders.

- Ability to handle multiple brands, suppliers, and product categories simultaneously.

- Strong commercial judgment regarding inventory purchasing and cash flow.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- High levels of independence, attention to detail, organization, and accountability.

- Genuine experience using AI tools to improve analytical or operational workflows.



### Especially Valuable Experience



- Inventory planning for fashion brands with multiple sizes, colors, and variants.

- Managing inventory across several ecommerce businesses.

- Developing stockout-adjusted demand forecasts.

- Seasonal merchandise planning and promotional demand forecasting.

- Working with overseas manufacturers and international shipping timelines.

- Building inventory dashboards and automated monitoring systems.

- Experience with Asana, inventory planning software, ERP systems, Make, Zapier, n8n, or scripting.



## THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



You need someone else to tell you what to reorder every month.



You believe inventory management is primarily about updating spreadsheets.



You wait until inventory runs low before contacting suppliers.



You are uncomfortable challenging forecasts or making data-driven recommendations.



You have only worked on order processing, inventory data entry, or shipment tracking without owning demand planning.



You need continuous guidance or approvals for routine operational decisions.



Or you think AI is just a convenient tool for answering occasional questions.



**We want an exceptional operator who is analytical, commercially intelligent, technologically capable, and relentlessly proactive.**



## YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



**First 30 Days — Learn the Business and Find the Risks**



Understand our brands, inventory systems, products, suppliers, and existing forecasting automations.



Validate the current classification of best sellers, rising best sellers, and underperformers.



Identify immediate stockout risks and purchasing opportunities.



Establish accurate inventory visibility and a prioritized action plan.



**Days 31–60 — Take Ownership**



Independently manage our replenishment planning process.



Establish regular coordination with marketing teams.



Take responsibility for supplier communication, purchase order tracking, and forecasting accuracy.



Begin improving our automated forecasting and inventory monitoring workflows.



**Days 61–90 — Make Inventory a Competitive Advantage**



Demonstrate improved visibility, proactive purchasing, and reduced inventory risk.



Show that major replenishment decisions are being made before stock becomes critical.



Deliver a clear, reliable reporting system that leadership can trust.



Most importantly, demonstrate that the business no longer needs senior leadership to personally keep inventory planning on track.



## WHAT WE OFFER



**Competitive compensation for proven talent.**



We are prepared to pay a premium for someone who can demonstrate exceptional forecasting, operational judgment, and ownership.



**Real responsibility.**



You'll have meaningful influence over inventory purchasing, working capital, supplier relationships, and revenue protection across multiple businesses.



**An AI-forward environment.**



We're investing heavily in automation and modern operational systems. You'll be encouraged to improve how the business operates.



**A growing portfolio of brands.**



You'll gain experience across multiple ecommerce categories, supply chains, and business models.



**The opportunity to build something exceptional.**



This is not a maintenance role. You'll be responsible for improving a financially critical business function and helping it scale as we grow.



## HOW TO APPLY



We're not interested in generic resumes filled with phrases like "detail-oriented" and "excellent problem solver." **We want proof.** Please apply on this link here: 



### Our Selection Process



We will shortlist applicants based on demonstrated experience, analytical judgment, and evidence of genuine ownership. We will be doing atleast two rounds of interviews through this hiring process.



## ONE FINAL THOUGHT



A great inventory manager does more than prevent operational problems.



They protect revenue.



They free up capital.



They help marketing teams grow faster.



They identify opportunities before competitors do.



And they build systems that allow the entire business to operate more effectively.



**We don't want someone who tells us what's out of stock.**



**We want someone who makes sure our winning products are in stock before anyone even thinks to ask.**



If that's the kind of responsibility that excites you, we'd love to meet you.

title: GoHighLevel AI Bot Specialist (Snapshot + Conversation AI + Client Support)
description:
GOHIGHLEVEL AI BOT SPECIALIST - Snapshot + Conversation AI Owner (Full-Time, Remote, Long-Term)



READ FIRST: I only consider a FRESH Loom recorded for THIS job. No old or reused videos. Start the video by saying SHIP, answer the questions below OUT LOUD, and show one real build on your screen. Recycled or written-only applications are not reviewed.



ABOUT US

CloseLeadPro gives health and wellness creators a complete automated sales system - their website, their AI employee, their follow-up - built on GoHighLevel. We run around 170 client sub-accounts from one master snapshot. Every client gets the same two Conversation AI bots: one that sells, and one that looks after customers after they buy.



That AI employee is the product. It is the reason clients pay us and the reason they leave. Right now the founder is the only person improving it, and that is the single biggest bottleneck in this company. This role exists to take it off him.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

You own our AI employee and our master snapshot. You make the bot measurably better every week, you prove that it got better, and you can explain what you built to the client whose business depends on it.



THE WEEKLY LOOP - THIS IS THE REAL JOB

1. Read real client conversations. Find where the bot answered badly, stalled, invented something, or lost the sale.

2. Work out WHY. Not "the AI is weird" - which instruction caused it.

3. Propose the smallest change that fixes it without breaking anything else.

4. Get it approved, test it, then roll it out properly.

5. Report what changed and whether the complaints went down.



If you have only ever written prompts and never gone back to see how they performed in the real world, this is not your role.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- The master snapshot: workflows, pipelines, funnels, custom values, custom fields. It stays clean and it stays current.

- Both Conversation AI bots - the sales bot and the customer service bot. Prompt structure, instructions, knowledge, testing.

- The custom value architecture. Our bot content lives in custom values, not hardcoded in each account, so one correct change reaches every client.

- Rolling changes out properly: custom values first, then every affected account, and always the master snapshot. A fix that only lands in one place is not a fix.

- Deploying and QA-ing new client sub-accounts from the snapshot.

- Regression testing. We keep a list of the ways the bot has failed before. Nothing goes live until it passes that list.



YOU WILL ALSO TALK TO CLIENTS - PLEASE READ THIS PART CAREFULLY

We have around 100 clients. You are not their daily support person, but you will get on calls with them, and this part of the job is not optional.



- When an account is built, you check it is set up correctly, then you get on a call and walk the client through it.

- When we release a new automation or a new feature, you present it to clients and explain, in plain words, what it does for their business.

- When something has gone wrong, you explain it calmly and clearly, without hiding behind technical language.



Our clients are not technical. Most of them are women in their 40s and 50s running their own business. They do not want to hear about workflows and custom values. They want to know what changed, why it helps them, and what they need to do.



If you are brilliant with systems but go quiet on a call, please do not apply for this one. We need both, and we will test both.



HOW WE WORK

- You propose, I approve, then it goes live. Every addition or removal to a bot prompt is shown to me before you make it and again after. This is not a trust issue - a single bad prompt change reaches 170 client accounts and every one of their customers.

- I tell you the outcome I want. You come back with it working.

- You document what you build. A short Loom and a short written SOP, every time.

- We do not over-engineer. The simplest version that works, wins.



YOUR ONE NUMBER

Bot complaints per week, going down. That is how we know you are winning.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Real, demonstrable GoHighLevel experience. Snapshots, sub-accounts, workflows versus campaigns, custom values, SaaS mode, Conversation AI. Certificates are not enough - show me builds.

- Hands-on work with LLM prompts in a product that real customers used. Tell me what broke and what you changed.

- You can read a bad AI output and reason backwards to the instruction that caused it.

- Strong spoken English and real confidence on video. You will be on calls with North American business owners every week, presenting your own work.

- You can explain a technical thing to a non-technical person without making them feel stupid.

- Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and JSON. You can read documentation and integrate without hand-holding.

- Some JavaScript or Python for the places no-code runs out.

- Careful by nature. You test before you ship, and you tell us when you are unsure.

- Self-directed. You unblock yourself.



NICE TO HAVE

- n8n, Make or Zapier.

- Courses, memberships or community portals in GoHighLevel.

- Experience with a fleet of client accounts rather than one business.

- Customer success or account management experience alongside the technical work.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 8 working hours a day, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week.

- Shift: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time, which is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern.

- Breaks: one 1-hour unpaid break, or two 30-minute breaks.

- This is a full-time role. You will not be holding another job or other clients during these hours. I will ask you about this directly, and I would much rather hear it now.



ANSWER THESE IN YOUR LOOM

1. Describe a GoHighLevel snapshot you built and deployed across several sub-accounts. What was in it, and what broke when you deployed it?

2. What is the difference between a workflow and a campaign in GoHighLevel, and when do you use custom values?

3. Tell me about a bot or AI prompt you built that failed with a real user. What did it do wrong, and what did you change?

4. How often were you on calls with clients in your last role, and what were those calls about?

5. What else are you working on right now, and what would you end to take this role?



THEN DO THESE TWO THINGS, LIVE IN THE VIDEO



First. Talk me through how you would train a Conversation AI to be a good sales agent. How do you structure its instructions, how do you stop it making things up, and how do you make it better once it is live and talking to real people?



Take your time with this one. It is the most important thing I will listen to.



Second. Pretend I am your client. I am 52, I run my own health business, and I am not technical at all. You have just finished setting up an automation that follows up with everyone who comments on my Instagram posts. Explain to me, out loud, what you built and why it helps me. Two minutes, in plain English.



I am listening to how you think, and to how you sound when you have to explain your work to the person paying for it.



TO APPLY

Record a FRESH 4 to 5 minute Loom made only for this job. Say SHIP, answer the 5 questions out loud, walk me through one real GoHighLevel or AI build on your screen, then do both of the exercises above. Paste the Loom link in your application.

title: Executive Administrator for Remote Accounting Firm
description:
Chief of Staff & Executive Administrator



ABOUT SIMPLE FINANCIALS



Simple Financials is a growing bookkeeping, accounting, tax, and CFO advisory firm operated primarily by our outstanding team in the Philippines.

We help small business owners improve how they use QuickBooks Online and provide accurate financial reporting, analytics, and ongoing financial guidance. Our firm continues to grow through new clients, expanded services, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

We are hiring a Chief of Staff & Executive Administrator to help coordinate the company, strengthen our administrative systems, support our leadership team, and serve as a trusted partner to John, our Founder and CEO.

This is not a traditional executive assistant position. We are looking for an executive-level administrator and developing Chief of Staff who is also willing to perform detailed executive assistant work when needed.

The right person will be comfortable moving between companywide administration, accounting support, hiring, process development, meeting leadership, project coordination, and direct support for the Founder.



THE PURPOSE OF THIS ROLE



Simple Financials has grown to the point where important administrative and leadership responsibilities cannot remain concentrated with only the Founder and Director of Operations.

This person will help create greater accountability, organization, and redundancy throughout the company. They will make sure recurring responsibilities are completed, important projects continue moving, and leadership has accurate information when decisions need to be made.

At the same time, this person will take ownership of many of the responsibilities currently consuming the Founder’s time, including
, scheduling, meeting preparation, communication, and project follow-up.

Success in this role will allow the Founder to focus more of his time on:

- Acquiring other accounting firms

- Strategic partnerships

- Senior-level hiring

- Funding opportunities

- Business development

- New service offerings

- Long-term company strategy



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Company Administration and Coordination

- Coordinate recurring administrative responsibilities across the company.

- Maintain PTO records, employee trackers, and administrative calendars.

- Review payroll information and timesheets for completeness and unusual activity.

- Assist employees with payroll and administrative onboarding matters.

- Confirm that background checks, employment documents, and security requirements are completed.

- Ensure team members have proper systems access and two-factor authentication.

- Maintain organized records, checklists, and recurring administrative procedures.

- Identify responsibilities that currently depend on only one employee and establish backup coverage.

- Help leadership ensure important company obligations are completed accurately and on time.

- Facilitate internal meetings when other leadership team members are unavailable.



Accounting, Billing, and Management Support

- Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate collection follow-up.

- Maintain client pricing and monthly billing information.

- Assist with quotes and proposals for prospective clients.

-Maintain management reports related to:

- Staff capacity

- Revenue by client

- Monthly billing

- Client profitability

- Staff profitability

- Staff utilization

- Accounts receivable

- Leadership scorecards

- Identify missing, unusual, or inconsistent financial information and follow up with the appropriate team member.

- Help leadership improve spreadsheets, dashboards, and recurring reporting systems.

- Provide administrative support for accounting projects without being responsible for all technical accounting work.



A strong understanding of accounting and QuickBooks Online is important because this role will regularly work with financial information, accountants, client billing, management reports, and accounting firm processes.



Hiring and Employee Onboarding

- Draft and update job descriptions.

- Coordinate interviews and communicate with candidates.

- Participate in interviews for selected positions.

- Maintain candidate notes, scorecards, and assessment results.

- Coordinate reference checks and background checks.

- Prepare onboarding schedules for new employees.

- Help create a professional and consistent employee experience from recruiting through onboarding.



Processes, Quality Control, and Security

- Help write, organize, and maintain critical company processes.

- Turn rough notes, meeting transcripts, and recorded instructions into clear procedures.

- Coordinate quarterly quality assurance and quality control reviews.

- Track whether required QA/QC procedures have been completed.

- Identify missing processes, outdated documentation, and single points of failure.

- Maintain an organized company process library.

- Help ensure employees follow required privacy, security, and confidentiality procedures.

- Recommend improvements to recurring administrative and operational systems.



Leadership Meetings and Company Follow-Through

- Help organize leadership and all-hands meetings.

- Prepare agendas, scorecards, reports, and supporting documents.

- Gather department updates before meetings.

- Attend important company meetings and document decisions, assignments, and deadlines.

- Distribute action items and follow up with responsible team members.

- Maintain a central list of major company projects and leadership commitments.

- Identify overdue or stalled projects and escalate them when necessary.

- Provide leadership with concise updates without requiring them to repeatedly request information.

- Help keep meetings focused, organized, and productive.



Executive Support for the Founder

A major part of this role will be creating leverage for John, the Founder and CEO.

Responsibilities will include:

- Reviewing and managing John’s
 account throughout the workday.

- Routing
s and requests to the appropriate departments or team members.

- Identifying urgent, sensitive, or time-sensitive matters requiring John’s attention.

- Drafting responses for
s John needs to answer.

- Responding directly to routine communications when authorized.

- Organizing, prioritizing, and maintaining the inbox.

- Tracking
s that require action or follow-up.

- Giving John short, organized summaries of matters requiring a decision.

- Managing John’s calendar and scheduling internal and external meetings.

- Protecting time for strategic projects and reducing unnecessary meetings.

- Preparing agendas, documents, and background information before meetings.

- Attending John’s important Simple Financials meetings.

- Tracking commitments and projects assigned by John.

- Following up with employees on projects where clients or team members are depending on John.

- Helping manage John’s LinkedIn account and selected social media content.

The goal is for John to manage decisions and strategy rather than manage his inbox, calendar, and routine follow-up.



Strategic and Special Projects

- Support acquisitions, partnerships, software evaluations, and company growth projects.

- Conduct initial research and organize supporting information.

- Coordinate communication between internal and external participants.

- Track deadlines, decisions, and next steps.

- Prepare short summaries and decision documents.

- Help ensure projects continue moving when leadership attention shifts.

- Assist with light sales, marketing, recruiting, and business development activities.

- Represent the Founder in selected internal discussions after earning the necessary trust and authority.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate combines accounting knowledge, administrative excellence, leadership potential, and executive judgment.

We will prioritize candidates who have:

- A degree or professional background in accounting.

- Significant experience using QuickBooks Online.

- Experience as an executive administrator, Chief of Staff, executive assistant, operations professional, or project coordinator.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Fast and dependable response times during working hours.

- Strong professional
 communication.

- A polished and professional on-camera presence.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- The ability to communicate confidently with employees, clients, and company leadership.

- The ability to respectfully hold others accountable.

- Sound judgment regarding what should be handled, delegated, escalated, or brought to the Founder’s attention.

- The ability to protect confidential financial, employee, client, and company information.

- A willingness to perform both strategic work and detailed administrative tasks.

A CPA credential is strongly preferred but is not required.

Candidates will complete a QuickBooks Online assessment so we can evaluate their current knowledge. Some QBO and accounting training can be provided, but candidates with strong existing accounting and QBO experience will receive priority.

Less-experienced candidates are also welcome to apply. We may consider promising applicants at a lower starting rate and provide additional paid training.



AI AND TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS



The successful candidate must be an advanced and responsible user of AI and modern productivity tools, including:

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- Perplexity or comparable research tools

- QuickBooks Online

- Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

- Meeting transcription and summarization tools

- Project management and documentation systems

- Advanced spreadsheets

This person should be able to use AI to:

- Draft and summarize
s

- Produce meeting notes and action lists

- Create procedures and job descriptions

- Research candidates, vendors, and opportunities

- Organize information for leadership decisions

- Improve spreadsheets and administrative workflows

- Prepare reports and executive summaries

AI-generated work must always be reviewed for accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound judgment.



WORK SCHEDULE AND HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS



Most working hours must overlap with the U.S. Central Time Zone because this person will manage the Founder’s inbox, attend meetings, and communicate with leadership throughout the U.S. workday.

Applicants must have:

- Reliable high-speed internet

- A dependable computer

- A professional camera and microphone

- A quiet and private workspace

- The ability to participate professionally in confidential client and company meetings



OUR COMPANY CULTURE



Simple Financials is a supportive and growing company. We treat our team members in the Philippines as respected professionals and client-facing experts—not as anonymous outsourced workers.

Your ideas, feedback, and professional judgment will be important to our success.

We want someone who:

- Is positive, kind, and enjoyable to work with

- Holds themselves to a high professional standard

- Is highly self-directed and organized

- Accepts feedback without becoming defensive

- Continually looks for ways to improve

- Takes ownership of responsibilities and outcomes

- Wants to build a long-term career with our company

- Is willing to step into leadership as the company grows

We genuinely care about our team members. If a client is disrespectful to someone on our staff, we will prioritize our employee’s well-being over keeping that client.

Our goal is to create a company where the right people can remain for five, ten, or more years while continuing to grow professionally, personally, and financially.



COMPENSATION AND LONG-TERM ADVANCEMENT



The expected compensation path for a successful candidate is:

- Starting compensation: $7 USD per hour

- After approximately three to six months of successful onboarding: $8 USD per hour

- After approximately one additional year: $9 to $12 USD per hour, depending on performance, accounting knowledge, leadership ability, and overall success in the role

Less-qualified candidates may be offered a lower starting rate with additional paid training.

This position also includes opportunities for annual raises, profit sharing, and expanded leadership responsibilities.

As Simple Financials grows and acquires additional firms, a high-performing candidate may progress into a senior Chief of Staff, executive operations, or company leadership position.

Over the next three to five years, long-term compensation may potentially grow to approximately $30,000 to $40,000 USD annually, depending on the company’s growth, the person’s performance, and the responsibilities they assume.



BENEFITS



Paid Time Off



Vacation leave begins accruing when you start:

- 15 days per year during years one and two

- 18 days per year during years three and four

- 21 days per year after five years

Unused vacation leave may be paid out as cash the following year according to company policy.



Paid Holidays



Simple Financials currently observes the following paid holidays:

Health Insurance Reimbursement



Simple Financials provides a monthly reimbursement of up to $30 USD toward qualifying PhilHealth and Social Security System payments.



Profit Sharing



Eligible team members may participate in the company’s profit-sharing program after completing the required onboarding and eligibility period.



Company Retreats



We generally organize two to three in-person retreats or team outings each year to strengthen relationships and give our remote team opportunities to spend time together.



Additional Bonuses



Simple Financials periodically provides additional bonuses related to holidays, birthdays, Mother’s Day, personal milestones, or exceptional performance.



How to Apply



To Apply, please click the following link -

title: CONTENT CLIPPER / SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
$600/MONTH + EXTRA VIDEO BONUSES + PERFORMANCE BONUSES

We are a growing fashion and lifestyle brand looking for a short-form content editor with a strong understanding of **what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.**



This is NOT a job where we give you timestamps and tell you exactly what to clip.



We have a large library of:



- YouTube/vlog footage

- Lifestyle footage

- Business conversations

- Fashion and product discussions

- Behind-the-scenes footage

- Travel content

- Raw conversations

- B-roll



Your job is to **watch the footage yourself, understand the context, identify the strongest moments, and turn those moments into content people want to watch.**



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE

Content will primarily be used for:

- TikTok

- Instagram Reels

- YouTube Shorts



Most clips will be vertical, although some horizontal content may also be used.



We require a minimum of:

**25 APPROVED CLIPS PER WEEK**



Approximately:

**100 APPROVED CLIPS PER MONTH**



Quality matters just as much as quantity.



Simply exporting a video does not automatically mean it counts toward your weekly total. We are looking for clips that we would genuinely want to post.



WE WANT SOMEONE WITH CONTENT INSTINCTS



You should be able to watch raw footage and recognize:

- A funny moment worth clipping

- A strong business insight

- An interesting story

- A fashion opinion

- A good product explanation

- A behind-the-scenes moment

- Something relatable

- Something people will want to comment on or share



Some videos may only need 15–30 seconds. Others may need 60–120+ seconds to properly tell the story. Your job is to understand the difference.



We do NOT want someone who needs to be told where every clip begins and ends.



EDITING STYLE

We want clean, engaging editing.

You may use:

- B-roll

- Zooms/punch-ins

- Speed changes

- Clean transitions

- Sound effects when appropriate

- Memes/references when appropriate

- Creative pacing



Do not make the videos feel overly edited or corny.



We will generally handle:

- Music

- On-screen hooks

- Captions/subtitles

- Post captions

- Titles

- Descriptions



You should primarily deliver **clean edits using the original audio.**



COMPENSATION

Starting compensation:

**$600 USD/month**

We begin with a **30-day trial period.**



The base expectation is:

**25 approved clips per week.**



You can earn more by creating additional approved content.

For every **5 additional approved clips beyond the weekly minimum**, you earn: +$25**



Example:

25 approved clips = Base compensation 

30 approved clips = +$25  

35 approved clips = +$50  

40 approved clips = +$75  

45 approved clips = +$100



PERFORMANCE BONUSES

If one of your clips performs exceptionally well organically:

**100K views → +$25**

**250K views → +$50**

**1M+ views → +$100**



We count whichever individual platform the video performs best on. Views from different platforms are not combined.



Our goal is simple:

**The better the content you create, the more opportunity you have to earn.**



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for long-term relationships. If you're great at finding content and consistently creating strong clips, there is room for:

- Increased compensation

- More responsibility

- More footage

- Additional bonuses

- Long-term work with our team



We may also hire multiple clippers if we find multiple people who are exceptional at this. 

We are producing a lot of content and want to become **impossible to ignore.**



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited.

2. Your best-performing video and how many views it received.

3. Why you believe that video performed well.

4. What editing software you use.

5. A short explanation of how you would approach a 45-minute vlog if we gave you no timestamps.

6. Confirmation that you can consistently deliver 25+ approved clips per week.



Start the subject line of your application with:

**I FOUND THE CLIP** so we know you read this listing thoroughly. 



If you need someone to tell you exactly what moments to edit, this position is not for you.



If you can watch raw footage, find moments other people overlook, and turn them into great content, we want to hear from you.

title: Video Assistant for Educational Videos
description:
International Test Preparation Company 🚀



➡️ Your role

We are looking for a video assistant to help us produce engaging videos. You will work with VEED, a browser-based video editor. The work is straightforward: you’ll mainly add slides and B-roll, and occasionally display text on screen.



Please only apply if you enjoy looking for suitable B-Roll and editing dynamic videos. This role is not about occasionally adding B-Roll. It's about consistently selecting and incorporating the right B-Roll to make our videos visually interesting, engaging, and enjoyable to watch.



➡️ Your skills

✅ You enjoy looking for suitable B-Roll and creating dynamic videos. Experience with VEED is a plus but not essential. You will get a guide on how to use VEED.

✅ You are detail-oriented and creative.

✅ You can speak and write English fluently and accurately.



➡️ Your payment

We pay $2 per basic video and $5 per dynamic video. Payment will be made via Wise or Easypay.



If we feel we're a good fit, we’ll invite you in for a paid trial.



🏢 Our team

We are JuvaPrep, a growing international test preparation company based in the UK, helping students around the world prepare for IELTS, TOEFL, and CELPIP — three of the leading English-language tests used for admission to top universities and for immigration purposes. Our YouTube channels have more than 250,000 subscribers, and over 10,000 students have enrolled in our test preparation courses. We are a young, international team working remotely from different parts of the world.



➡️ How to apply

Send us an application via onlinejobs.ph messages with the subject line:

Video Assistant Application – [Your Name]



Tell us about your video editing experience and why you are interested in the job. Please visit speedtest.net, run a speed test using the internet connection you would use for work, and include the direct link to your results generated by speedtest.net in your application. 



Incomplete applications may not be considered. To show you read this job post carefully, include the word ‘JuvaPrep’ after your name in the subject line.



If you enjoy creating dynamic videos, we would love to hear from you!

title: Client Support Specialist (GoHighLevel / SaaS)
description:
CLIENT SUPPORT SPECIALIST - GoHighLevel (Full-Time, Remote, Long-Term)



READ FIRST: I only consider a FRESH Loom recorded for THIS job. No old or reused videos. Start the video by saying FIXED, then answer the questions below OUT LOUD - spoken, not typed. Recycled or written-only applications are not reviewed.



ABOUT US

CloseLeadPro gives health and wellness creators a complete automated sales system - their website, their AI employee, their follow-up - built on GoHighLevel. Our clients are not technical. They are business owners, and almost every one of them came to us because another client told them to.



That is the whole company in one line. When a client wins, we grow. When a client's request sits for three days, they cancel and they stop referring.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

A client writes in with something broken or something they want changed. You go into their GoHighLevel account and fix it - today.



THE SCOPE IS SMALL. THE JUDGEMENT IS NOT.

Clients only ever ask for a handful of things. A wrong link. The Ai bot said something odd. Change this wording. My calendar is not working. Connect my social account. You will know the whole list inside a week.



The hard part is d
 correctly and quickly, every single time:

- What did this person actually ask for, not what is easiest to answer?

- Can I fix this myself right now, or does it genuinely need someone else?

- Is this one client's problem, or is it happening to everybody?



That judgement is what we are hiring. Everything lives in GoHighLevel. There is nothing else to learn.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- It is not reading from a script.

- It is not passing tickets to someone else.

- It is not sending the client a list of steps so they can do it themselves.

If you would rather explain the fix than make the fix, this is the wrong job and you will not enjoy it here.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Answer every client message quickly and kindly, on chat and
.

- Go into their GoHighLevel sub-account and make the change yourself: wording, links, workflows, settings, bot replies, calendars, contacts.

- Own the request until the problem is actually gone.

- When you cannot solve it, pass it to a named person with a time, then tell the client that. Never leave someone waiting in silence.

- Keep the client health tracker current. Know who is drifting before they cancel.

- Call the quiet and the unhappy clients. Short calls, early.

- Bring us the complaints that keep repeating, so we fix the product instead of answering the same message fifty times.

- Record a short Loom for each new thing you learn. These become our training library.



YOUR ONE NUMBER

The percentage of client requests you resolve the same working day. We tell you that number every week. Everything else is secondary to it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years in customer support, client success, or senior BPO support for a software or agency business.

- Real hands-on GoHighLevel. Not a certificate. Actual sub-accounts, workflows, calendars, custom values. If you have not used GHL, you must show us that you learn a system by opening it and clicking through it, not by waiting for a manual.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on client calls.

- You finish things. You follow up without being reminded.

- You notice what the person actually asked for, not what is easiest to answer.

- You say quickly and clearly when you do not know something.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 8 working hours a day, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week.

- Shift: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time. That is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern, so you are awake while our clients are.

- Breaks: one 1-hour unpaid break, or two 30-minute breaks.

- This is a full-time role. You will not be holding another job or other clients during these hours. I will ask you about this directly.



ANSWER THESE IN YOUR LOOM

1. How many client conversations did you handle in a day at your last job, and how many of those did you resolve yourself without passing them on?

2. Tell me about a time you fixed something for a client that was not technically your job.

3. What have you actually built or changed inside GoHighLevel? Be specific.

4. What is your English like, spoken and written? Are you comfortable on video calls?

5. What else are you working on right now, and what would you end to take this role?



THEN HANDLE THIS, LIVE IN THE VIDEO

A client writes: "I have asked you three times to change the wording my bot sends to people who comment on my posts. It is still wrong and it is going out to my own audience. What is the problem?"



You do not know our product and that is fine. We are not testing product knowledge. Reply to her out loud the way you actually would, then tell me what you would do in the next ten minutes.



TO APPLY

Record a FRESH 3 minute Loom made only for this job. Say FIXED, answer the 5 questions out loud, then handle the client message above. Paste the Loom link in your application.
